findings.title: 对比按 (平台,邮箱) 去重：重复远端记录被静默折叠，重传产生的重复不可见
findings.impact: 用户看不到重复账号，无法清理；对比只针对其中一条，delete_old 删一条后另一条仍在，形成「已上传但显示未上传/仅远端」的循环；本地重复行中凭证更好的那条可能恰好被隐藏。
findings.fix_hint: 把重复项显式建模（同一 key 保留列表，输出 `duplicates` 计数或额外行），或在对比 payload 里回显 remote_count 与去重后的行数差异并告警。
findings.evidence: services/panel_comparison.py:505-509 `remote_by_key[key] = item`（后写覆盖，重复记录只剩最后一条）；:518 `key in seen` 让同一 (平台,邮箱) 的第二条本地行整行消失。触发：CPA 同一邮箱存在 `a@x.com.json` 与重传后的 `a@x.com-1.json` 两条 auth file（本仓库推送/重传是常态），或本地重复注册同一邮箱。

findings.title: refresh=true 绕过锁内二次检查：并发刷新变成 N 次串行全量重建
findings.impact: 刷新风暴时远端请求量 = 并发数 × 全量（最坏 200 次凭证下载），面板可能被限流；用户等待时间随并发线性增长，而结果完全相同。与「单飞重建」的初衷相反。
findings.fix_hint: refresh 也做锁内复查：记录 `entry['monotonic']`，若等锁期间已有**晚于本次请求开始时间**的重建完成，直接返回该结果；或用一个 per-panel 的 generation 计数做合并。
findings.evidence: services/panel_comparison_cache.py:236-248：进入 `_rebuild_lock` 后 `if not refresh:` 才做新鲜度复查，`refresh=True` 直接 `_rebuild_panel_comparison`。两个标签页同时点「刷新对比」→ 第一个重建完成后第二个仍会重建（等锁串行）。CPA 重建含最多 `_MAX_CREDENTIAL_FETCH=200` 次 download（panel_comparison.py:708，实测注释 ~94ms/次）。

findings.title: CPA 注册表只声明 chatgpt，但对比/拉取包含 grok → Grok 行恒「未上传」且推送必失败
findings.impact: CPA 页面上 Grok 账号永远显示「未上传」，批量推送每次产生 N 条失败告警，用户无法通过筛选规避；两个页面（面板管理/账号页）对同一面板的能力声明互相矛盾。
findings.fix_hint: 二选一对齐：`_PANEL_PLATFORMS['cpa']` 去掉 grok（与注册表一致），或注册表补 grok 并显式声明不可上传、由 push_local_rows 按声明过滤。加一致性测试 `set(_PANEL_PLATFORMS[k]) <= set(PANELS_BY_KEY[k]['platforms'])`。
findings.evidence: services/panel_registry.py:72-81 `platforms:['chatgpt']`、upload_actions 只有 chatgpt；services/panel_comparison_cache.py:143 `'cpa': ('chatgpt','grok')`；services/panel_comparison.py:686-687 缺省 allowed=codex+xai。结果：PanelComparisonPanel.tsx 的 `shouldShowPlatformFilter(['chatgpt'])` 为 false（平台选择器不渲染），Grok 行无法筛掉；services/panel_push.py:389-393 对 grok 行返回 `Grok 已不再支持 CPA 上传`，每次推送都计入 failed。

findings.title: 远端读成功但解析为空 → 一次拉回静默撤销该面板全部登记
findings.impact: 登记表被清空后这些账号不再参与拉回（plan_sync 早退 not_enrolled），恢复只能重新推送成功；用户看到的是「拉回 0 个」，日志里只有逐账号 warning。静默的数据破坏（prior 审计 T6-3 同点，工作树仍在）。
findings.fix_hint: `sync_local_from_remote` 只在 `remote_accounts` 非空且解析确认完整时执行撤销；解析层对未知形状抛错走 remote_error；或把撤销改成显式动作并在响应里回显 revoked 计数。
findings.evidence: services/panel_sync.py:240-257：`remote is None` 时对每个本地行 `reconcile_with_remote(present=False)` 并落库，没有「远端列表为空/被截断」的保护；services/panel_comparison.py:740-760 `_sub2api_extract_items` 对不认识的响应形状返回 `[]`（200 空体/网关错误页同样落这里），panel_comparison_cache.py:264-278 此时 `remote_error=''`。触发：面板升级改字段或反代返回 200 `{}` → POST /sync → 所有本地行的 `panel_uploads` 被删。

findings.title: `npm run lint` is red: 28 errors + 4 warnings in 8 files (exit 1) — the repo's own lint gate cannot pass
findings.impact: `npm run lint` (package.json:10, `eslint .`) fails on the working tree, so any CI/pre-commit step that runs it blocks the build, and the 28 errors are all real (empty block at Settings.tsx:472 — see L08-1; 6× no-explicit-any in Settings; 15 in Accounts). A permanently-red gate trains people to ignore it.
findings.fix_hint: Fix the empty catch (L08-1) and the `any`s; if `no-explicit-any` is intentional in the detail panels, scope an override in eslint.config.js rather than leaving the whole repo red.
findings.evidence: `cd frontend && npx eslint .` → `✖ 32 problems (28 errors, 4 warnings)` exit 1. Error split: Accounts.tsx 15E, Settings.tsx 10E, RegisterTaskPage.tsx 1E, components/settings/ConfigPanels.tsx 1E, components/account/AccountDetailParts.tsx 1E = 28E. Warnings (4): Settings.tsx 1W (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` at :422), MailImportPanel.tsx 2W, PanelConfigPanel.tsx 1W. Confirms controller's 28E/4W, Accounts 15E, Settings 10E; adds that all 28 errors sit in 5 files and the 4 warnings in 3 others.

findings.title: Task log stream treats any non-2xx as terminal — one transient 5xx freezes the log panel for the rest of the task
findings.impact: A 502/500/503 from the SSE endpoint (backend restart, tunnel hiccup, worker busy) permanently stops streaming for that task: the panel keeps the last lines and shows “日志流连接失败 (502)” while the task keeps running and writing logs. User sees a dead log window and may assume the task died. Repro: open a running task's log modal, restart the backend once (or inject one 503 on /api/tasks/{id}/logs/stream) — panel never reconnects.
findings.fix_hint: Treat 5xx/408/429 as retryable (return false and let the existing exponential backoff run); only stop on 401/403/404 (deleted task). Show the retry countdown in the same error line.
findings.evidence: connectStreamOnce(): `if (!response.ok) { setError(`日志流连接失败 (${response.status})`); return true }` (TaskLogPanel.tsx:205-208). Its return value is the loop's “stop” flag: `const shouldStop = await connectStreamOnce(); if (shouldStop || cancelled) return` (:276-278). Retry/backoff (:275-284) is only reached for network errors (return false), never for an HTTP status.

findings.title: Proxy enable/disable toggle has no error handling — PATCH failure is an unhandled rejection with zero UI feedback
findings.impact: When the PATCH fails (403/500/proxy row already deleted), nothing happens: no toast, no reload, button stays in its old state, and the promise rejects into the console. User cannot tell a failed toggle from a missed click and will retry blindly. Trigger: open /proxies, stop the backend (or delete the row in another tab), click the enable/disable icon.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap in try/catch → message.error(`切换失败：${errMsg(e)}`), and only call load() on success; disable the button while the request is in flight.
findings.evidence: `const toggle = async (id: number) => { await apiFetch(`/proxies/${id}/toggle`, { method: 'PATCH' }); load() }` (Proxies.tsx:239-243), bound at :497 `onClick={() => toggle(record.id)}`. No try/catch anywhere on the path; contrast the sibling handlers `del`/`batchDel`/`toggleTag` which all catch + message.error.

findings.title: `npm run check` discards every script's stdout to /dev/null and validates no script's `checked` count
findings.impact: A failing check is indistinguishable from a crashing one, and an empty-iteration check is indistinguishable from a thorough one. The only place a floor is asserted is tests/test_frontend_running_tasks_cap.py (`result['checked'] >= 13`), for one script.
findings.fix_hint: Drop the `> /dev/null` (or tee to a log and print the last line on failure). Add a shared helper that fails when `checked < N` for each script.
findings.evidence: `"check": "for f in scripts/run_*.mjs; do node \"$f\" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo 'all checks passed'"`. The 25 scripts that print `{checked, failures}` do so on stdout only, so on failure the operator sees exit 1 and zero diagnostics. No script is required to assert a minimum `checked`; e.g. run_dashboard_tasks_checks reports checked=2, run_kiro_derived_paging_checks checked=3 - a loop over an empty discovered list yields checked=0, failures=[] and exit 0.

findings.title: Two 'frontend' check scripts assert on backend Python source text
findings.impact: A frontend gate red-lines on a Python refactor and vice versa; the coupling is invisible from either side, and the check is still only a substring match on the Python file (same weakness as L09-2).
findings.fix_hint: Move these assertions into the pytest suite where the Python symbol can be imported and called, and keep the frontend script to frontend inputs.
findings.evidence: `readFileSync(new URL('../../platforms/grok/plugin.py', import.meta.url), 'utf8')` in run_grok_batch_default_checks.mjs:13, and `readFileSync(new URL('../../core/config_schema.py', ...))` in run_maintenance_keys_checks.mjs:18. Discovered when running `npm run check` in a scratch copy that contained only frontend/: it died with `path: '/root/.hermes/cache/scratch/platforms/grok/plugin.py'`.

findings.title: check_dead_tests.py only sees tests inside `if __name__ == "__main__"` and silently skips files that fail to parse
findings.impact: The gate's name and docstring promise 'no test can never be collected'; it covers exactly one of at least five ways a test becomes uncollectable. It reports exit 0 (4.00s) today, which is read as 'no dead tests'.
findings.fix_hint: Fail on SyntaxError rather than continue. Cross-check pytest's own `--collect-only` count against the number of `def test_*` in tests/ (AST) and report the delta - that catches every skip/shadow class at once.
findings.evidence: find_dead_tests() walks only `tree.body` guards matched by _is_main_guard (line 51-56). main() has `except SyntaxError: continue` (line 70-71) - a test file with a syntax error is dropped from the scan instead of reported. Nothing detects: @pytest.mark.skip/skipif, a TestCase class with __init__ (pytest warns and skips the whole class), a file renamed off the test_*.py glob, or a test shadowed by a duplicate class definition.

findings.title: The pytest-side typecheck gate self-skips when node_modules is absent - '3929 passed' can mean tsc never ran
findings.impact: On a clean CI checkout (no npm install) the only pytest-visible typecheck gate, the only eslint-baseline gate and 4 frontend contract tests all skip silently; the run is green and reports 'passed'. The skip is unconditional - it does not distinguish 'developer laptop' from 'CI'.
findings.fix_hint: Skip only when an explicit env var (e.g. ALLOW_MISSING_NODE=1) is set; otherwise fail with an actionable message. In CI, `npm ci` before pytest.
findings.evidence: `test_typescript_still_compiles` calls `self.skipTest("未安装 npx —— 跳过 tsc 编译检查")` when shutil.which('npx') is None and again when frontend/node_modules is missing, before running `npx tsc -b`. Same pattern: 4 `@pytest.mark.skipif(not os.path.isdir(frontend/node_modules))` decorators in tests/test_frontend_running_tasks_cap.py:23,44,67,94. tests/test_maintenance_doc.py:108 has the same skip for the eslint baseline check.

findings.title: Collected-test-count gate is one-directional with 41% slack: asserts >=2300 while the suite collects 3929
findings.impact: 1,629 tests (41% of the suite) can be deleted, skipped or made uncollectable and this gate still passes. The number is also stale in both docs (2300+/3514 vs 3929), so it no longer measures what the author thought.
findings.fix_hint: Pin `collected == 3929` (updated with the suite) or a floor within 2% (>=3850), and have it fail on a drop as well as a parse failure. Update MAINTENANCE.md and the pytest.ini comment.
findings.evidence: `test_collected_test_count_is_in_the_documented_ballpark` runs `pytest tests/ --collect-only -q`, parses `(\d+) tests collected` (actual: 3929) then `self.assertGreaterEqual(collected, 2300)`. docs/MAINTENANCE.md:502 says '2300+ 用例' and pytest.ini:17 says 'pytest tests/ -> 3514 collected'.

findings.title: 跨库 used 回填函数从未被调用，默认分库布局下邮箱池不会标记已用地址
findings.impact: 分库后「已注册邮箱回写池」的兜底是死代码：历史 used 状态无法收敛，池会把已在 chatgpt/grok 用过的地址再次发出去，注册端撞「邮箱已被占用」白跑一轮。JSON 账号后端下同一函数也只读 SQL，同样看不到账号。
findings.fix_hint: 在 init_db() 的 run_migrations() 之后调用一次 `sync_outlook_used_across_databases()`（它已做分批与去重）；或让 _sync_outlook_used_status 接受「外部邮箱集合」参数，由 run_migrations 汇总后传入。
findings.evidence: `grep -rn sync_outlook_used_across_databases --include=*.py` 仅命中定义处与 __all__，无调用点。实测默认布局（accounts 在默认库、池在 data/platforms/outlook.db）：插入 account(shared@x.com) + outlook 池 available(shared@x.com)，跑 `run_migrations()` 后池状态仍是 `available`；手动调用 `sync_outlook_used_across_databases()` 后才变 `used`。原因：`_sync_outlook_used_status()` 要求同库同时有 accounts 与 outlook_accounts，两个库各缺一张表，双双 return。

findings.title: 唯一索引两套定义：手写链建 (platform,email)，模型/Alembic 建 (platform,lower(email))
findings.impact: 只跑手写链的库拿到大小写敏感的约束：`USER@X.AI` 可以插到 `user@x.ai` 旁边（正是 b7c1e4a92d30 要修的 bug），而两条链谁先跑决定最终定义 —— 同一份代码在不同安装上约束强度不同。
findings.fix_hint: 手写链改成表达式索引：先 `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uq_accounts_platform_email`（仅当定义不匹配时）再建 `(platform, lower(email))`；或直接删掉手写这段，由 Alembic/模型单点负责。
findings.evidence: 手写：`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_accounts_platform_email ON accounts (platform, email)`（migrations.py:417-420）；模型 models_account.py:36-42 与 Alembic b7c1e4a92d30:59-64 都是 `(platform, lower(email))`。b7c1e4a92d30 的注释自己承认「老库可能已被手写迁移建过同名但不同定义的索引」。实测应用自建库索引列为 `(platform, email)`，Alembic 空库为 `(platform, lower(email))`。

findings.title: 生产平台库缺模型声明的索引：source / consecutive_failures 三处全表扫
findings.impact: `claim_alias` 的 `WHERE consecutive_failures < N`、远程同步的 `WHERE source='remote'` 在 2339 行上走全表扫；模型与真实库索引不一致，`alembic check` 永远发现不了（include_object 排除池表且只连默认库）。
findings.fix_hint: 把这三条加进 `_ensure_hot_query_indexes()` 的 wanted（列存在才建，已是幂等写法），或在补列的同一函数里紧跟 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS。
findings.evidence: 对真实库跑 PRAGMA 对比模型：`data/platforms/icloud.db` 的 icloud_accounts 缺 `ix_icloud_accounts_source`；icloud_aliases 缺 `ix_icloud_aliases_source`、`ix_icloud_aliases_consecutive_failures`（2339 行）。这些列由 `_migrate_icloud_remote_schema()`/`_migrate_icloud_aliases_schema()` 的 ALTER 补出（migrations.py:561-584、314-321），`_ensure_hot_query_indexes()` 的 wanted 表只覆盖 task_logs/accounts/icloud_aliases 的 4 条，不含上述三条；create_all 不改既有表，Alembic 又完全不管平台库。

findings.title: 邮箱池显式指向默认库时，启动迁移会把刚建好的池表删掉
findings.impact: core/db/base.py:206-207 明确支持「显式配置可以覆盖或改指到别处」，把池与默认库同库是合法配置；该配置下每次启动都丢表，outlook 池页面/取号全挂。同理适用于 DATABASE_URL_ICLOUD。
findings.fix_hint: DROP 前加一条排除：`if platform_database_registry.url_for('outlook') == str(engine.url)` 或 `url_for('icloud') == ...` 时跳过对应表；或只删「不在 configured_platforms 里」的池表。
findings.evidence: `_drop_stale_pool_tables_from_default_db()` 只判「engine.url == DATABASE_URL」且表为空就 DROP。实测 `DATA_DIR=<scratch> STORAGE_BACKEND=sqlite DATABASE_URL_OUTLOOK=sqlite:///<scratch>/account_manager.db python -c "...init_db()..."` → init_db 里 register_schema 先建出 outlook_accounts，随后被删；最终 `tables: ['accounts','configs','proxies','task_logs','task_runs']`（无 outlook_accounts）。再查 `platform_session('outlook')` → `no such table: outlook_accounts`。

findings.title: 每次进程启动都全表重扫/重写 extra_json：1.7k 账号稳定态 3.6s
findings.impact: main.py 与 services/turnstile_solver/api_solver.py:214 每个进程启动都付一次；账号上万后线性放大到几十秒，容器重启/多 worker 场景明显。且这些函数无「已迁移」标记，永远重复扫。
findings.fix_hint: 加一张轻量 schema_meta(key,value) 记录每个一次性迁移已完成（或复用 alembic_version 的 revision 语义）；_scrub/_encrypt 至少先 count(*) WHERE extra_json LIKE ... 短路，或改为按需迁移。
findings.evidence: 对生产库副本逐函数计时（_run_one 同参单跑）：_scrub_extra_passwords 0.966s、_encrypt_plaintext_extras 0.942s、_ensure_account_email_unique 0.518s、_migrate_used_platforms_columns 0.306s、_normalize_grok_token_column 0.117s；默认库合计约 2.9s。整体 run_migrations() 稳定态 3.59s，init_db() 冷启动 16.7s / 次启 14.5s（1734 账号、5353 日志）。两处都是 LIKE 全表扫（password / 冒号）+ 每命中行 json.loads/json.dumps。

findings.title: migrate_legacy_paths 只搬 .db，不搬 -wal/-shm：热 WAL 的提交留在旧路径
findings.impact: 老布局（库在仓库根）且已开 WAL 的部署，升级后主库被搬到 data/，8MB 级的未 checkpoint 帧仍留在根目录 account_manager.db-wal：轻则新库缺最近写入（数据静默回退），重则旧 -wal 被后续以旧路径打开的程序重放到另一个文件。data_bundle.py:683-687 明确处理了同一问题，路径迁移这里漏了。
findings.fix_hint: _migrate_path 对 .db 源同时搬 <name>-wal/<name>-shm（存在才搬，目标同名已存在则按现有「不覆盖」策略跳过并报告）；或搬前用 sqlite3 backup API 做一次 checkpoint 快照再删源。
findings.evidence: _LEGACY_MOVES 仅三项：根目录 account_manager.db、.secrets/credential_key、solver.log；_migrate_path() 用 shutil.move(source,target) 单文件搬移，无 -wal/-shm 处理。本机实测该库确实在用 WAL：ls -la data/ → account_manager.db-wal 8,540,792 字节、-shm 32,768。

findings.title: data/secrets/credential_key 权限 0644（全局可读），代码只在创建时设 0600
findings.impact: 这把 AES-256-GCM 密钥解开账号的 AT/RT/SSO/cookies/密码；同机任意本地用户（或误挂卷进容器的其他进程）可直接读走全部凭据。属于凭据暴露，不是功能 bug。
findings.fix_hint: _load_or_create_key() 读到已有文件时 os.chmod(path, 0o600)（并对 SECRETS_DIR 设 0o700）；ensure_data_dirs 里给 SECRETS_DIR 显式 mode=0o700。
findings.evidence: stat -c '%a %n' data data/secrets data/secrets/* → 755 data / 755 data/secrets / 644 data/secrets/credential_key（700 只有 totp_journal）。代码 os.open(path, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC, 0o600) 只在文件不存在时生效，已存在的 0644 文件永远不会被收紧。

findings.title: CPA 上传把任何 200/201 当成功，不读响应体
findings.impact: 对端以 200 + `{"success":false,...}` / `{"error":...}` 表达业务失败时（同类面板的常见风格），本地记「上传成功」，账号实际没进面板；注册链会把这条当已完成，后续没人再补传。
findings.fix_hint: 与 chatgpt2api 分支对齐：解析 JSON，认 `success/ok` 字段与 `error(s)`；解析失败或字段缺失时至少记 warning 并把响应体前 200 字带进 message。
findings.evidence: sed -n '273,275p' platforms/chatgpt/cpa_upload.py -> `if response.status_code in (200, 201): return True, "上传成功"`（只有非 2xx 才解析 message）。对照 chatgpt2api_upload.py:318-348 会解析 added/skipped/errors 并在 `errors and not added and not skipped` 时判失败。

findings.title: 登录链在邮箱未命中老号时静默改走注册，新随机密码不回写 → 库里密码/2FA 与账号脱节
findings.impact: 被删号/被清空的账号走「刷新 Token」时会新建一个同名账号并返回 success，凭据写回原行；但该行 extra 里仍是旧密码（和旧 totp_secret）。下一次走密码登录刷新必然失败，2FA 绑定也会用错种子 —— 表现为「刷新成功过一次，之后这个号再也救不回来」。
findings.fix_hint: 登录链不应默默建号：`run_protocol_login` 遇到 signup() 判为新号时抛「账号不存在（需重新注册）」；若确实要保留该能力，则把 register_password 生成的新密码/新 totp_secret 一并回写（或至少清空旧 password 并在结果里标 `re_registered=true`）。
findings.evidence: sed -n '1118,1131p' platforms/chatgpt/protocol/auth_flow.py -> `is_new = self.signup(email, sentinel); if is_new: logger.warning("目标邮箱未命中已有账号分支，回退到注册链路"); self.register_password(email); ... self.create_account()`；register_password 内 `self.result.password = self._random_password()`（mixins/signup.py:303-304）。写回侧 plugin.py:560-571 只 patch access_token/refresh_token/session_token/id_token/cookies/device_id，**不含 password**。

findings.title: sdk.js 缓存非原子写入：并发注册可读到半截文件，且坏文件被进程内永久缓存
findings.impact: auto_loop 多 worker 同时首跑时，B 进程可在 A 的 write_bytes 中途看到 size>0 的残文件并缓存它 → node 加载 sdk.js 报 SyntaxError → `QuickJS 执行失败` → Sentinel RuntimeError → 该 worker 的注册全部中止；因为 `_sdk_file_cache` 已指向残文件，后续每次取 token 都失败，直到进程重启（粘性故障）。
findings.fix_hint: 写临时文件 + `os.replace()` 原子替换；读侧校验完整长度（比对 Content-Length 或存一个 `.sha256`/`.size` 伴随文件）后再缓存；缓存命中前做一次 `node --check sdk.js` 太贵，用长度校验即可。
findings.evidence: sed -n '50,82p' platforms/chatgpt/protocol/sentinel_quickjs.py -> `if sdk_file.exists() and sdk_file.stat().st_size > 0: _sdk_file_cache = sdk_file; return sdk_file` … `sdk_file.write_bytes(content); _sdk_file_cache = sdk_file`（无 tmp+rename、无 flock；判据只有 size>0）。

findings.title: sub2api 上传把 expires_in 写死 863999，与真实 exp 自相矛盾
findings.impact: 对端若按 expires_in 排刷新计划，会认为 AT 还有 10 天，实际 ChatGPT AT 远短于此 → 面板侧长期拿着过期 AT 打接口，账号在面板上「在线但全 401」，本地却显示正常。两个字段同源不同值，属于跨服务契约自相矛盾。
findings.fix_hint: `expires_in = max(0, expires_at - int(time.time()))`，与 expires_at 同源；缺 exp 时不要编造 10 天，传空/省略并让对端按自己的默认值处理。
findings.evidence: sed -n '105,125p' platforms/chatgpt/sub2api_upload.py -> `expires_at = access_payload.get("exp")` … `"expires_in": 863999, "expires_at": expires_at`（expires_in 是常量，只有 expires_at 来自 JWT）；缺 exp 时 :109 还把 expires_at 兜成 `now + 863999`。

findings.title: session 路拿回未通过校验的 AT 时，OAuth 的 permanent 分类被丢弃 → 永久失效的号状态不变
findings.impact: 只有「session 返回 200+AT 但 AT 打 /backend-api/me 不过」且「OAuth 回 invalid_grant」这一组合命中；命中时 plugin 上报 refresh_kind=""，apply_chatgpt_status_policy（services/chatgpt_account_state.py:276）不落 invalid，账号继续显示正常。这正是注释里声称已修好的「失效号界面一直显示正常」。
findings.fix_hint: 返回 session_result 前把 oauth_result.kind / error_message 合并进去（`session_result.kind = session_result.kind or oauth_result.kind`），或直接返回 oauth_result 并附上 session 的 verify_message；另外给 refresh_by_session_token 的 401 分支也补 classify_refresh_error。
findings.evidence: sed -n '386,394p;421,433p' platforms/chatgpt/token_refresh.py -> session 成功但 `_verify` 不过时 `session_result = result`（此时 result.kind 恒为空，refresh_by_session_token 全程不设 kind，见 :209-220/:264-267）；OAuth 失败后 `if oauth_result.banned: return oauth_result` / `if session_result is not None: return session_result` —— oauth_result.kind（classify_refresh_error 得出的 permanent）在此被丢掉。

findings.title: 批量补 RT / 绑 2FA 的选号没有 banned 谓词
findings.impact: 封禁号通常既没有 RT 也没有 2FA 密钥，于是在「补 RT / 批量绑 2FA」里被选中，跑完整条登录链（PoW + OTP 等待）后才靠 looks_like_banned 收场；与 local_maintenance 里「banned 不刷新，白费出口 IP」的既定策略相反，批量任务会反复烧同一批死号。
findings.fix_hint: 在 select_chatgpt_accounts 的 all_filtered 分支默认加 `status != banned`（显式传 status=banned 时才放行），或让两个 select_*_targets 的 keep 里排除 BANNED_ACCOUNT_STATUS。
findings.evidence: sed -n '100,114p' services/chatgpt_account_selection.py -> all_filtered 分支只在 `if status:` 非空时加 `AccountModel.status == status`；select_backfill_targets（services/chatgpt_rt_backfill.py:55-66）与 select_two_factor_targets（services/chatgpt_two_factor.py:66-76）只传调用方给的 status + keep(缺 RT/缺 2FA)，没有排除 banned。api/tasks.py:355-368 直接把 req.status（前端未筛选时为空）透传。

findings.title: Outlook 收件箱回退查询把邮箱本地部分直接拼进 LIKE，`_`/`%` 未转义可命中别人的信箱
findings.impact: 地址 `john_doe+tag@outlook.com` 的 pattern 变成 `john_doe+%@outlook.com`，其中 `_` 是单字符通配 → 可能匹配 `johnXdoe+abc@outlook.com` 这一行（完全不同的信箱），于是 provider 去读错收件箱，等码等满一个 OTP 超时；命中多行时 `.first()` 结果不确定，同一账号两次行为可能不同。
findings.fix_hint: `like(f"{escape_like(base_local)}+%@{domain}", escape="\\")`（对 `% _ \\` 做转义），并加 `order_by(OutlookAccountModel.email)` 保证确定性；或改成先按 domain+`+` 前缀拉候选再在 Python 里精确比较 local part。
findings.evidence: sed -n '290,306p' services/chatgpt_otp_mailbox.py -> `base_local = local.split("+", 1)[0]` … `OutlookAccountModel.email.like(f"{base_local}+%@{domain}")`（无 escape，`.first()` 无 order_by）。

findings.title: 每日自动刷新只按 status 选号，不看 refresh_kind/disabled → 永久失效的号每天被整链重刷
findings.impact: refresh 落 `refresh_permanent` 的号 status=invalid，仍落在 REFRESHABLE 集合里；每日定点任务会为它重跑 session→OAuth→协议登录（含最多 180s OTP 等待）整条链，永远拿不到新 RT，纯烧出口 IP 与风控额度，也让「失效」与「可救」在界面上无法区分。
findings.fix_hint: Pick 增加 `refresh_kind`/`auto_refresh_disabled` 字段，select_refresh_targets 的 failed 档排除 `refresh_kind==permanent` 或 `disabled=true` 的号；或在 _iter_picks 里读 extra 的 chatgpt_token_refresh / chatgpt_auto_refresh。
findings.evidence: sed -n '296,305p' services/local_maintenance.py -> `refreshable = [a for a in rows if a.status not in NON_REFRESHABLE_STATUSES]` / `return [a for a in refreshable if a.status in REFRESHABLE_STATUSES]`（REFRESHABLE_STATUSES={expired,invalid,limited}，:77）；_iter_picks:368-395 只带 id/email/status/last_probe_at，没有 `chatgpt_token_refresh.refresh_kind` 也没有 `chatgpt_auto_refresh.disabled`（后者的消费方只有手动恢复链 services/task_runners.py:1559-1617）。

findings.title: AccountStatus.is_active() restricts the scheduler probe to 'registered', making the expired/invalid -> registered recovery branch unreachable
findings.impact: The scheduled 有效性检查 can only demote, never restore: expired/invalid accounts stay out of the pool until a human clicks 检测, while the code reads as if automatic recovery exists. It also means the scheduler never re-tests exactly the accounts whose credentials might have recovered.
findings.fix_hint: Select candidates as `status != banned` (or active|expired|invalid), keeping banned sticky; or delete the dead branch and document that recovery is manual.
findings.evidence: `is_active()` returns `{cls.REGISTERED.value}` only (core/base_platform.py:84-91) and is the sole selector for the batch probe: `accounts = [r for r in rows if AccountStatus.is_active(r.status)][:limit]` (core/scheduler.py:194). The recovery branch it feeds, `if fresh.status in ("expired", "invalid"): fresh.status = "registered"` (core/scheduler.py:210), can therefore never see those rows.

findings.title: `mailbox=` is a required constructor argument at the only call site but is not declared on BasePlatform
findings.impact: The documented plugin contract is wrong: a new plugin written against BasePlatform.__init__ raises `TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'mailbox'` on the first registration attempt, and the requirement is only discoverable by reading task_runners. It also means `self.mailbox` is not guaranteed to exist, so `BasePlatform.bind_task_control` (line 282) has to use getattr.
findings.fix_hint: Declare `def __init__(self, config: RegisterConfig = None, mailbox: BaseMailbox | None = None)` on BasePlatform (store self.mailbox, bind task control there) and delete the four per-plugin copies.
findings.evidence: Base: `def __init__(self, config: RegisterConfig = None)` (core/base_platform.py:219). Call site: `_platform = PlatformCls(config=_config, mailbox=_mailbox)` (services/task_runners.py:685). Every current plugin hand-rolls the extra kwarg: grok/plugin.py:187, aws/plugin.py:84, kiro/plugin.py:84, chatgpt/plugin.py:97.

findings.title: probe_account_detail()/last_probe_detail is a de-facto plugin contract (3 of 4 platforms) that BasePlatform never declares
findings.impact: A plugin that forgets either attribute gets its accounts marked invalid on any failed check with an empty detail dict, and there is no place in the base class that tells an author these two names exist. The 'indeterminate' semantics that aws/kiro rely on (usable=None) are likewise undocumented at the contract level.
findings.fix_hint: Declare `last_probe_detail: dict = {}` and `def probe_account_detail(self, account) -> dict: return {"usable": None, "indeterminate": True}` on BasePlatform; make the default check_valid a thin wrapper over it.
findings.evidence: Base declares only `apply_probe_status_policy` (core/base_platform.py:252-261). `probe_account_detail` + `last_probe_detail` are implemented ad hoc by grok (plugin.py:325, 306), aws (plugin.py:298, 320) and kiro (plugin.py:559, 583) and absent on chatgpt; core reads them defensively - `detail = getattr(plugin, "last_probe_detail", {}) or {}` (core/scheduler.py:207, api/accounts.py:1031) - and falls back to `fresh.status = "invalid"` when the policy hook is the base no-op (core/scheduler.py:223-226).

findings.title: registry.load_all() swallows ModuleNotFoundError raised *inside* a plugin, so a platform can vanish from the UI with no diagnostic
findings.impact: If any transitive import inside platforms/<x>/plugin.py is missing (optional dep not installed, renamed module, partial deploy), that platform silently disappears from GET /api/platforms (api/platforms.py:9 returns _registry.values()) and get('x') raises KeyError "平台 'x' 未注册，已注册: [...]" (core/registry.py:54-55) - which reads as 'platform retired', not 'import failed'. No traceback is ever logged.
findings.fix_hint: Catch ImportError, `logger.exception(...)` and record failures in a module-level `_load_errors` surfaced by list_platforms(); only swallow when `exc.name` is exactly f"platforms.{name}.plugin".
findings.evidence: `sed -n '37,48p' core/registry.py` -> `try: importlib.import_module(f"{module_name}.plugin")` / `except ModuleNotFoundError: pass`. The module has no logger at all (imports are only importlib/pkgutil/typing), so "plugin.py does not exist" and "plugin.py imported a missing dependency" are the same silent outcome.

findings.title: Grok _sso_status can never return 'rejected' (Response has no url) yet still costs a live request on every check_valid
findings.impact: For the default grok account shape (SSO only, no AT - `grok_oauth_exchange` defaults to "0", plugin.py:157-168) every `check_valid` performs an extra GET to https://accounts.x.ai whose verdict can only be `alive` or `unknown`; that value is then passed as `sso_rejected=(detail.get("sso_status") == "rejected")` (plugin.py:318-323), so the 'SSO 被拒 -> invalid' branch in services/grok_account_state.py:106-107 is dead while still looking load-bearing.
findings.fix_hint: Delete `_sso_status` and the sso_status/sso_rejected plumbing (the 测活 action already refuses to use it), or add `url` to Response and judge on the final URL - do not keep a network call that cannot change the verdict.
findings.evidence: `final = str(getattr(r, "url", "") or "")` (platforms/grok/plugin.py:431) but `Response` is `@dataclass class Response: status_code/text/headers/cookies` with no url field (core/base_executor.py:8-12) and `ProtocolExecutor._wrap` builds it without one (core/executors/protocol.py:25-32). The function's own docstring (plugin.py:391-404) records that `rejected` is unreachable.

findings.title: Kiro drops a freshly created AWS Builder ID when the address already has a Kiro row (raise before the source account is saved)
findings.impact: Trigger: the mailbox/auto path hands an address that already has a kiro row (retry after a task that saved Kiro but reported failure, or a reused mailbox). The AWS account has been created upstream (email consumed, password set) and is then thrown away - no `aws` row, no Kiro row, no log line - burning both the account and the mailbox while the only trace is a RuntimeError that talks about Kiro.
findings.fix_hint: Move the `is_email_registered` check before `aws_platform.register()` (the explicit-email path already does this at plugin.py:419), or save the source AWS row before raising so the burned account is at least recoverable.
findings.evidence: In `_register_aws_identity`, the duplicate guard runs after `aws_platform.register(...)` has already created a real Builder ID with a password: `if self.is_email_registered(account.email): raise RuntimeError(...)` at platforms/kiro/plugin.py:172-173, while the block that persists the source AWS account (and whose own comment says "来源账号**立即落库**：Kiro 授权失败时 AWS 号已经真实存在…丢掉它就等于白烧一个号") only starts at line 175 and calls `account_repository.upsert(source_record)` at line 192.

findings.title: AWS/Kiro status policies assign AccountStatus enum members instead of .value - downstream `str(status)` comparisons break
findings.impact: Concrete break: services/local_maintenance.py:463 `if revert_banned_mark and str(acc.status or "") == "banned" ...` never matches after the aws/kiro applier ran, so the '标记为禁用' off-switch is a no-op for AWS/Kiro (the ban mark is never reverted). Same mis-compare inside the policy itself (kiro/plugin.py:592 `str(getattr(account,'status','')).lower() != AccountStatus.REGISTERED.value`) makes an already-registered row report "探测通过，恢复为正常" on every probe. DB writes happen to stay correct only because sqlite binds the str subclass by its underlying value.
findings.fix_hint: Assign `.value` in both policies (or `AccountStatus.coerce(...)` then `.value`); add a regression test asserting `type(acc.status) is str` after apply_probe_status_policy for aws/kiro.
findings.evidence: `account.status = AccountStatus.BANNED` at platforms/kiro/plugin.py:593/597/599 and platforms/aws/plugin.py:331/335/337, while every other writer stores the string (`setattr(account, "status", AccountStatus.BANNED.value)`, services/grok_account_state.py:101). `AccountStatus` is `class AccountStatus(str, Enum)` (core/base_platform.py:19), so on py3.11 `str(AccountStatus.BANNED)` == 'AccountStatus.BANNED', not 'banned'.

findings.title: 调度器失败不推进 last_run_at 且无退避：永久失败的维护任务每 60s 重试一次并 print 到 stdout
findings.impact: 配置错误/DB 锁/平台未注册这类永久失败会以 60s 频率无限重试，日志被刷屏（异常文本还可能带上游 URL 与 key，见 L13-10）；同时长任务把 `log_auto_cleanup`、面板同步等其它 job 全部饿住，维护窗口内其它任务实际停摆。
findings.fix_hint: 失败计数 + 指数退避（60s→5m→30m→1h 封顶），连续 N 次后把 job 标记为 degraded 并只在状态变化时打日志；用 `logger.exception` 代替 `print`；长任务改成线程池/子线程执行，避免串行饿死。
findings.evidence: `core/scheduler.py:173-186`：`try: job.runner(); job.last_run_at = time.time() except Exception as e: print(f"[Scheduler] 周期任务 {job.name} 错误: {e}")` —— 注释明确「失败时不推进 last_run_at，下一次 tick（默认 60s）就重试」，没有失败计数、没有退避上限。`_loop` 是单线程串行（:151-152），一个 job 跑多久，后面的 job 就等多久；`local_maintenance.py:447-448` 每个账号 `time.sleep(3)`，全量探活 200 个号 ≈ 10 分钟。

findings.title: 全局 _SMS_VERIFY_LOCK 在「不复用号码」的默认配置下也被持有整个验证窗口，所有接码任务被串行化
findings.impact: 并发的注册任务在 add-phone 这一步全部排队：一个号从租到收码最长 80s×3 次尝试，期间其它任务的 `get_phone()` 全阻塞——默认配置下这个串行化没有任何收益。更糟的是没有超时：某个任务因异常没走到 cleanup（或跨线程 release 失败被吞），这把 RLock 就永久被占，之后所有接码任务无限期挂起。
findings.fix_hint: 只有 `provider.reuse_phone_to_max` 为真时才拿锁；`acquire(timeout=…)` 并在超时时抛出可读错误；`_release_lock` 记录 `RuntimeError` 而不是静默吞掉（跨线程 release 是真实风险）。
findings.evidence: `controller.py:93-95`：`if isinstance(provider, SmsActivateProvider) and not self._verify_lock_acquired: _facade._SMS_VERIFY_LOCK.acquire()`，只在 `report_success()`（:201）或 `cleanup()`（:240）释放。`create_sms_provider` 传的是 `reuse_phone_to_max=_safe_bool(config.get("sms_reuse_phone"), False)`（:54）→ 默认关闭复用，但锁照拿。缓存本身的读写早已由 `_SMS_CACHE_LOCK` 保护（providers.py:457）。`_release_lock`（:242-248）吞掉 `RuntimeError`，acquire 也没有超时。

findings.title: 接码 API Key 走 query string，requests 的 HTTPError 把整条 URL（含 api_key）带进日志/响应
findings.impact: 任何 4xx（key 失效、限流、IP 被封——正是用户会来点「查余额」的场景）都会把付费接码平台的 key 写进服务端日志，并被用户截图/贴日志带走；命中 :112 时直接回显到浏览器。
findings.fix_hint: `_request` 里 `try: resp.raise_for_status() except requests.HTTPError as exc: raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {resp.status_code} {resp.reason}") from None`（不要带 URL）；`api/sms.py` 的 detail 用固定文案 + 状态码，绝不插值 requests 异常。
findings.evidence: `providers.py:181-187`：`payload["api_key"] = self.api_key` → `requests.get(self.base_url, params=payload, ...)` → `resp.raise_for_status()`。requests 的 HTTPError 文本包含完整 URL。只读复现（不联网，构造 Response）：`python3 -c "import requests;r=requests.Response();r.status_code=401;r.url='https://smsbower.page/stubs/handler_api.php?api_key=SECRETKEY123&action=getBalance';r.reason='Unauthorized';r.raise_for_status()"` → `HTTPError -> 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://smsbower.page/stubs/handler_api.php?api_key=SECRETKEY123&action=getBalance`。`api/sms.py:97` 把这个 `exc` 原样打进日志：`logger.warning("查询短信余额失败（上游原文只进日志）: %s", exc)`（注释只说「上游原文」，没意识到 URL 里有 key）；`api/sms.py:112` 还会 `detail=f"查询国家排名失败: {exc}"` 回给前端。

findings.title: wait_for_code 把 unknown 状态（BAD_KEY/无余额/服务码错）当成「还没来短信」，白等满超时后再租一个号
findings.impact: key 失效/余额不足/服务码配错这类**永久错误**与「暂时没短信」不可区分：每次尝试都等满 timeout（add_phone 传 80s），然后上层 cancel + 换号，最多 3 次 → 为一个配置错误白付 2-3 个号的租金，日志里只有一行 `v2=unknown BAD_KEY`。
findings.fix_hint: 在 wait_for_code 里识别致命 token（`BAD_KEY`/`NO_BALANCE`/`BANNED`/`WRONG_SERVICE_ID`/`WRONG_COUNTRY`）立即抛 `RuntimeError`；或「连续 N 次 unknown 且 raw 不变」就中止。
findings.evidence: `providers.py:625-660` 的轮询只处理两种状态：`:639 if result.get("status") == "cancel"`、`:642 if result.get("status") == "ok"`，其余（含 `unknown`）直接进入下一轮 `time.sleep(poll)`。而 `get_status_v2` 把平台错误映射成 `{"status":"unknown","raw":...}`（:579-580），v1 的 `_parse_sms_status_text` 对 `BAD_KEY` 之类也返回 `unknown`（services/sms/parsing.py:72）。

findings.title: 接码号缓存写死 <repo>/data，绕过 DATA_DIR：容器里落在镜像层，且 0644 含 key 指纹
findings.impact: （1）号池复用缓存不随 DATA_DIR 走：容器重建即丢、备份/导出不含它，和 docs/DATA_DIRECTORY.md 承诺的「只挂一个卷」相悖；（2）只读根文件系统的加固部署里 `mkdir` 会抛 PermissionError，而它在 `get_number` 已经租到号之后执行（providers.py:493），异常冒出去时 `controller.activation` 还没赋值 → `cleanup()` 无从 cancel，白付一个号；（3）同机其它用户可读手机号与 key 指纹。
findings.fix_hint: 改成 `from core.paths import DATA_DIR; return DATA_DIR / ".sms_phone_cache.json"`；写入用 `os.open(..., 0o600)`/`path.chmod(0o600)`；`api_key_hash` 换成 HMAC（带进程内随机 key）或直接去掉（只用于区分不同 key 的缓存，sha256 前缀足够且不可逆性不是重点）。
findings.evidence: `services/sms_service.py:55-59`：`cache_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data"; cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); return cache_dir / ".sms_phone_cache.json"`。而 `core/paths.py:77` 是唯一口径：`DATA_DIR = _resolve_dir(_env("DATA_DIR"), project_root() / "data")`；`docker-compose.yml:47` 设 `DATA_DIR: /runtime` 并把 `./data` 挂到 `/runtime`，`.dockerignore:8` 又把 `data/` 排除出镜像 → 容器里 `/app/data` 根本不存在，运行时 `mkdir` 出来的是**镜像层**，不是持久卷。`_save_cache`（providers.py:370-382）用 `path.write_text(...)`，默认 0644，内容含 `api_key_hash`（sha256，parsing.py:19-20）、`phone_number`、`activation_id`。

findings.title: is_running() 把「任何 <500 的响应」当成自己在跑：端口被别的服务占用时永不启动、请求全打到错的服务
findings.impact: 8889 被任何别的进程占用（另一个 checkout 的 solver、开发服务器、反代）时，管理器不启动自己的 solver，`LocalSolverCaptcha` 把 `/turnstile` 发给陌生服务 → 404/HTML → `raise_for_status()`/`r.json()` 抛错，所有 Turnstile 求解失败；而 `/api/solver/status` 还报「运行中」，排查方向被带偏。
findings.fix_hint: 加一个可识别的健康端点（如 `/healthz` 返回 `{"service":"turnstile-solver","pid":...}`），`is_running()` 校验该字段而不是状态码；不匹配时明确报「8889 被其它进程占用」并拒绝启动/重启。
findings.evidence: `solver_manager.py:86-91`：`r = requests.get(f"{_solver_url()}/", timeout=2); return r.status_code < 500`；`start()` :100-102 `if is_running(): print("[Solver] 已在运行"); return`。404/401/403 都算「在跑」。`_solver_url()` 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8889`（:52-53）。

findings.title: solver 崩溃后无人重启，且 stop() 对已退出的子进程不 wait() → 永久僵尸 + 只能手动恢复
findings.impact: solver 被 OOM/segfault 杀掉后（2G 机器上 camoufox 很常见），Turnstile 全链路一直失败到有人手动点重启；死掉的子进程留在进程表里当 `<defunct>`，容器里 `init: true` 也不会替父进程收尸。
findings.fix_hint: 在 scheduler 或一个 daemon 线程里每 30-60s `poll()` 一次 `_proc`：已退出 → `wait()` 收尸并 `start()`；`stop()` 里无论 `poll()` 结果都 `try: _proc.wait(timeout=1) except: ...`。
findings.evidence: `start_async()` 只在 `main.py:193` 的 lifespan 里调一次；`grep -rn "solver_manager" --include=*.py .`（排除 .worktrees）只命中 main.py 的 `/api/solver/status`、`/api/solver/restart` 与启动/停止，没有任何周期性探活。`stop()` :166 `if _proc and _proc.poll() is None:` —— 子进程已经退出时整段被跳过，`_proc.wait()` 不会执行，随后 :179 `_proc = None` 丢掉句柄。

findings.title: _close_pool 从不 playwright.stop()，重建时又覆盖 _playwright → 每次回收泄漏一个 driver 进程
findings.impact: 空闲回收（默认 300s TTL）+ 下一次请求重建，每个周期泄漏一个 node driver 进程（几十 MB）；跑几天就是几十个孤儿，正是 :257-261 注释声称已修好的那个问题在 chromium 模式下的残留。
findings.fix_hint: `_close_pool` 末尾 `if self._playwright is not None: try: await self._playwright.stop() except Exception: ...; self._playwright = None`；`_initialize_browser` 里先复用已有的 `self._playwright`，不要无条件 `start()`。
findings.evidence: `_close_pool`（:347-373）关掉池内 browser、`session.__aexit__`，最后只 `self._playwright = None`；`grep -n "playwright.stop" services/turnstile_solver/api_solver.py` → 无命中。`_initialize_browser`（:404-419）每次补齐都 `playwright = await async_playwright().start(); self._playwright = playwright`，直接覆盖上一个实例。仅 chromium/chrome/msedge 模式（:412-419）走这条；camoufox 由 `AsyncCamoufox` 会话管理。

findings.title: /turnstile 接受任意 URL 且无鉴权：盲 SSRF + 把住宅代理当开放代理用
findings.impact: 任何能连到 8889 的进程/网页都能让服务器用自己的出口（且是付费住宅代理）访问任意地址。因为方法是 GET 且无鉴权，运维浏览任意恶意页面时一个 `` 就能触发（盲 SSRF，响应跨域读不到，故 P2）：可用于探测内网/打满浏览器池（每请求一个后台任务、无并发上限，见 L13-20）。
findings.fix_hint: `process_turnstile` 里先 `urlsplit`：只允许 `http/https`，解析 host 后拒绝私网/回环/链路本地（`ipaddress.ip_address(...).is_private` 等）与 `file:`/`data:`；再加一个可选的共享 token（`SOLVER_AUTH_TOKEN`）校验 header/query，默认只绑 127.0.0.1。
findings.evidence: `:1205-1225` `url = request.args.get('url')` → 存结果 → `_spawn(self._solve_turnstile(...))`；`:1034 await page.goto(url, wait_until='networkidle', timeout=30000)`。全文件没有任何 scheme/host 白名单（`grep -n "urlparse\|allowlist\|private\|169.254\|127.0.0.1" services/turnstile_solver/api_solver.py` 只命中代理解析），`file://`、`http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`、`http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/...` 都会被真实浏览器打开。路由注册在 :253，`GET` 方法、无任何鉴权。

findings.title: /turnstile 无并发上限：每个请求起一个后台任务并无限期阻塞在 browser_pool.get()，可被打满内存
findings.impact: 无鉴权的 GET 循环（或 L13-4 里任意网页的 `` 批量触发）可以在几秒内堆出上千个协程 + 上千条 pending dict（每条含完整 url/sitekey），内存单调上涨；真正的注册任务排在它们后面，`/result` 一直 processing。属于低成本 DoS。
findings.fix_hint: 用 `asyncio.Semaphore(thread_count*2)` 包住求解（超限直接回 `ERROR_BUSY`），或对 `_solve_tasks` 设上限（如 200）并在 `/turnstile` 入口 429；pending 项加 TTL，任务结束/超时即删。
findings.evidence: `:1205-1235` 每个请求 `save_result`（写一条带 url 的 pending 项）后 `_solve_task = self._spawn(self._solve_turnstile(...)); self._solve_tasks.add(_solve_task)`，没有信号量/队列上限/按 IP 限流；`_solve_turnstile` 先 `_ensure_pool()` 再 `:895 await self.browser_pool.get()` —— 池只有 `thread_count`（默认 1-2）只浏览器，第 3 个及以后的任务会**无限期**挂在 `Queue.get()` 上。`_ensure_pool`（:308）只补浏览器、不看排队任务数。

findings.title: solver 自己的 CLI 默认 --host 0.0.0.0：README 的手动启动方式绕过 127.0.0.1 兜底
findings.impact: 照 README 手动启动、或用 `LocalSolverCaptcha.start_solver()` 的部署，会把**无鉴权**的 `/turnstile`（任意 URL + 代理）暴露到局域网/公网，与 solver_manager 注释里「绝不能直接对外」的结论自相矛盾。
findings.fix_hint: `--host` 默认改 `127.0.0.1`，跨容器场景显式 `--host 0.0.0.0`（compose 已经这么设 `SOLVER_BIND_HOST`）；`start_solver()` 补 `--host 127.0.0.1`；README 的示例同步。
findings.evidence: `api_solver.py:1367` `parser.add_argument('--host', type=str, default='0.0.0.0', ...)`；`start.py:45 app.run(host=args.host, port=int(args.port))`。`README.md:345` 教用户手动跑 `python services/turnstile_solver/start.py --browser_type camoufox --port 8889`（不带 `--host`）→ 监听所有网卡。只有 `services/solver_manager.py:56-67 _solver_bind_host()` 在自动拉起时才显式传 `127.0.0.1`；`core/base_captcha.py:130-145 LocalSolverCaptcha.start_solver` 同样不传 `--host`（直接 `Popen`），也走 0.0.0.0。

findings.title: results_db 对「已解出」的结果永不清理：每解一次泄漏一个 dict，进程内无上界
findings.impact: solver 是常驻进程，`results_db` 每条求解留一个 dict（token 字符串 + 计时）永不释放；按每天数百次求解、跑几周算，内存单调上涨，最终把本已紧张的 2G 机器压到 swap。
findings.fix_hint: solved 结果也写入 `createTime`（或统一用 `finishedAt`）；`cleanup_old_results` 用 `res.get('createTime') or res.get('finishedAt')`，取不到时按 `now` 之外的值处理（如直接删）；再给 dict 加个硬上限（>10000 条时淘汰最旧）。
findings.evidence:
`db_results.py:23` `if isinstance(res, dict) and now - res.get('createTime', now) > days_old * 86400:` —— 已解出的结果由 `api_solver.py:1140/1168` 存成 `{"value": token, "elapsed_time": ...}`，**没有 createTime**，`get('createTime', now)` 取默认 `now` → 差值 0 → 永远不删；只有 pending 项（`api_solver.py:1220-1227` 带 createTime）会被清。实测（只读探针，直接 import 该模块，无网络/无文件写入）：
```

import sys, asyncio, time
sys.path.insert(0, "services/turnstile_solver")
import db_results as d
async def main():
    await d.save_result("t1","turnstile",{"value":"TOKEN","elapsed_time":1.2})

    print("deleted:", n, "remaining:", sorted(d.results_db))
asyncio.run(main())
```

findings.title: .dockerignore excludes only `.env`; `COPY . .` can bake `.env.*`, legacy DBs, and account/proxy files into the image

The legacy default DB path is `./account_manager.db` (core/paths.py:120), and `accounts.txt`/`proxies.txt` are gitignored (`.gitignore:26-29`) but not dockerignored.

findings.title: README calls pytest/tsc/eslint '质量门禁' but release.yml has no test/lint job
findings.impact: A tag push publishes an image with zero automated tests/typecheck/lint; the 'gate' set is a local convention only, so a broken tree can be released.
findings.fix_hint: Add a CI job (push + pull_request) running pytest, tsc -b, npm run check, and an eslint ratchet; make `image` depend on it.

findings.title: workflow_dispatch re-run cannot publish the requested tag: image job ignores inputs.tag and builds github.ref
findings.impact: Manual re-runs either fail with no tags for build-push-action or push an image built from the branch instead of the tagged commit; the advertised recovery path is broken.
findings.fix_hint: Pass the validated tag to the image job (`env: TAG: ${{ inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}`), set `actions/checkout` `ref: ${{ inputs.tag || github.ref }}`, and compute metadata tags from that value.
findings.evidence: release.yml:16-21 declares `workflow_dispatch.inputs.tag`; the release job reads it (lines 48-52 `INPUT_TAG`), but the image job only reads `REF: ${{ github.ref }}` (lines 150-155) and derives `TAG="${REF#refs/tags/}"`. On manual dispatch `github.ref` is `refs/heads/main` -> TAG=`main`, `docker/metadata-action` semver patterns (172-175) emit no tags, and `actions/checkout` (146) builds the branch, not the requested tag. The workflow header (line 8) advertises '手动重跑 ... 填 tag'.

findings.title: Runtime image runs as root and creates /runtime root-owned; compose has no user/capability hardening
findings.impact: A container compromise gives root in the container, and the bind-mounted ./data (DB + credential key) is owned by root on the host; a non-root runtime is a cheap extra boundary.
findings.fix_hint: Create a dedicated user in the runtime stage, chown /runtime, add `USER app`, and consider `read_only: true`, `cap_drop: [ALL]`, `security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true]` in compose.
findings.evidence: `grep -n '^USER' Dockerfile` -> no matches; the runtime stage starts at Dockerfile:25, `COPY . .` at :83, `mkdir -p /runtime ...` at :89, `ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini","--","/app/docker/entrypoint.sh"]` at :108. entrypoint.sh:21 does `chmod 700` on the key dir as root. `grep -n 'user:\|read_only\|cap_drop\|security_opt' docker-compose.yml` -> no hardening keys.

findings.title: Dockerfile never installs the patchright browser, although chromium solver mode is documented and uses patchright
findings.impact: Setting the documented `SOLVER_BROWSER_TYPE=chromium` in the image can fail at runtime with 'Executable doesn't exist' unless the two packages' browser revisions happen to coincide; only the camoufox default is guaranteed to work.
findings.fix_hint: Add `python -m patchright install --with-deps chromium` to the Dockerfile (and README bare-metal prerequisites), or drop the chromium option from .env.example if unsupported in the image.
findings.evidence: Dockerfile:72 installs only `python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox`; there is no `patchright install`. api_solver.py:20 imports `patchright.async_api`, and :413-416 selects it for `chromium/chrome/msedge`; .env.example:53-54 documents `SOLVER_BROWSER_TYPE=chromium`; deploy/account-manager.service:11 explicitly runs `python -m patchright install chromium`. Installed patchright 1.63 wants chromium revision 1243 while playwright 1.62 installs 1234 (`browsers.json`), i.e. separate browser revisions/caches.

findings.title: APP_TRUST_PROXY is read by code but absent from all deploy docs; behind nginx all clients share one backoff key
findings.impact: Without the variable every request behind nginx is keyed to 127.0.0.1, so one attacker's failed logins throttle every user (global 429 backoff), and logs/rate-limit decisions lose the real client IP. Setting it blindly without stripping inbound X-Forwarded-For allows spoofing, and the docs give no guidance.
findings.fix_hint: Add `APP_TRUST_PROXY` to .env.example and the DEPLOYMENT env table with the exact nginx requirement (`proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr` / strip client-supplied headers).
findings.evidence: DEPLOYMENT.md:123-146 env table has no `APP_TRUST_PROXY`; `grep -n APP_TRUST_PROXY .env.example docker-compose.yml README.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` -> no matches. core/net_utils.py:25-27 returns true only for `APP_TRUST_PROXY=1`, and :48-63 otherwise uses `request.client.host`; api/auth.py:274-279 uses that for login backoff. DEPLOYMENT.md:29/59 recommends a reverse proxy.

findings.title: AES-GCM 不绑定 AAD、信封不带 key id：密文可在账号/字段间搬运，密钥也无法轮换

findings.title: 四个 gate 脚本没有任何 CI/pre-commit 接线，只能靠人记得跑
findings.impact: check_no_secrets.py（:110 命中返回 1）、check_dead_tests.py（:78）、check_kiro_agent2api_export.py（:135）、frozen_verify.py（:90 返回 2）都能失败，但没有任何自动化会调用它们 —— 密钥字面量或死测试可以静默进 main。
findings.fix_hint: 加 ci.yml（push/PR）跑 `python scripts/check_no_secrets.py && python scripts/check_dead_tests.py tests && python scripts/check_kiro_agent2api_export.py`；check_no_secrets 再挂一个 pre-commit hook。
findings.evidence: `ls .github/workflows/` 只有 release.yml；`grep -rn "check_no_secrets|check_dead_tests|frozen_verify|check_kiro" .github/` 无命中；仓库根无 .pre-commit-config.yaml / tox.ini / Makefile。release.yml 只做 Release + GHCR 构建，不跑 pytest 也不跑脚本。

findings.title: 源库路径写错或没有 accounts 表时静默跳过并以 0 退出
findings.impact: `--source data/platforms/grok.dbb`（拼错）或源库是空 schema 时，输出「合计: 源 0 行」且退出码 0，cron/CI 把一次没合并任何东西的运行当成功，后续按文档清掉 PLATFORM_DATABASE_URLS 就会读到缺数据的库。
findings.fix_hint: 显式 --source 不存在或无 accounts 表 → 抛错/exit 2；只有自动发现的源允许跳过，并在报告里列出 skipped 及原因。
findings.evidence: core/db/merge.py:202 `if not source.exists(): continue`、:207 `if not _has_table(src, table): continue` —— 两者都不设 stats.total，随后 :289-300 _check_conservation 对 0==0 判通过；scripts/merge_platform_dbs.py:78-99 仍打印「【已合并】」并 return 0。

findings.title: 密码/令牌用无盐 sha256 前 12 位「打码」，弱口令可离线爆破
findings.impact: 快照文件/CI 日志里的 48-bit 无盐哈希对 6-10 位口令是可离线字典验证的（Pw-123 级别秒破）；结合 email 列等于一份可用的凭据清单。
findings.fix_hint: 改用 HMAC-SHA256(每次运行随机 key) 或只输出 `<set>/<empty>` 布尔；若要 diff 能力，用 keyed hash 并在退出时丢弃 key；输出前打印 PII 警告。
findings.evidence: scripts/dump_accounts.py:57-63 `_mask` 返回 `sha256:{hexdigest()[:12]}:len{len(text)}`，无盐无迭代；:82-83 对 token/password 列直接套用。同文件 :76-81 还逐行输出 email/user_id/cashier_url 原值，无任何 PII 警告。

findings.title: encrypt 的 --verify 只看 v1: 前缀、不试解密，错密钥或坏信封一律判合格
findings.impact: 配合 L17-2（错密钥新建）时，脚本会把「全部密文但一把也解不开」判成成功并 exit 0；密钥文件被替换、密文被截断同样检不出。这是该脚本唯一的完工判据，却只验形状不验可用性。
findings.fix_hint: 每张表抽样 N 行（或全量）做一次 decrypt_text 往返，journal 文件逐个 decrypt；CredentialKeyError 计数 >0 时 exit 1 并打印密钥路径。
findings.evidence: scripts/encrypt_existing_credentials.py:196-200 `if str(extra[key]).strip() and not is_ciphertext(extra[key])`；:185-188 对 password/token 同样只判前缀；core/credential_crypto.py:92-93 `is_ciphertext = startswith('v1:')`。main() 在非 dry-run 结束时直接 return _verify()（:248）。

findings.title: 代理口令与 --cookie 会话凭据经 argv 传递，ps//proc 与 shell history 可见
findings.impact: 同机/同容器的任何进程可 `cat /proc/<pid>/cmdline` 读到 `http://user:pass@host`；手工跑 `--cookie 'sso=...'` 时 x.ai 会话 cookie 还会进 shell history —— 等于账号接管凭据。
findings.fix_hint: 改为环境变量（GROK_MINT_PROXY / GROK_MINT_COOKIE）或 stdin/0600 临时文件传参；argv 只留非敏感开关。
findings.evidence: scripts/grok_turnstile_mint.py:310-312 定义 `--proxy` / `--cookie`；platforms/grok/turnstile_mint.py:296-305 组 args 时把 `--proxy {proxy}` 放进 argv 交给 subprocess.run；同文件 :311-317 注释已承认 TimeoutExpired 的 str 会带完整 argv（含代理密码），只是把异常文本脱敏了，进程命令行本身没脱敏。

findings.title: 下载前先 rmtree 整个 camoufox 缓存目录，失败即毁掉可用安装
findings.impact: 在已有可用浏览器的开发机/构建缓存上重跑，一旦 GitHub 不可达或资产 404，旧安装已被删掉、新安装没装上 → Solver 直接不可用，且没有回退路径。
findings.fix_hint: 先解压到 temp_dir 并校验，成功后用 rename 原子替换（旧目录改名 .old，成功后删除）；失败时保留旧目录。
findings.evidence: scripts/install_camoufox.py:280-282 `if install_dir.exists(): shutil.rmtree(install_dir)` 发生在 :290 下载之前；下载/解压失败在 :293-294 直接 SystemExit，finally 只清 temp_dir。

findings.title: camoufox 浏览器包只校验 zip 结构与 camoufox-bin 存在，无 checksum/签名
findings.impact: 构建期从 GitHub Release 拉取的 camoufox-bin 会被直接 exec（:238-241 恢复 +x），供应链上任何一次 release 资产替换/MITM 都变成镜像内的任意代码执行，而构建日志显示「成功」。
findings.fix_hint: 在 browser-pin.json 或同目录 checksums 文件里钉每个 (version,build,arch) 的 sha256，下载后先校验再解压；缺失校验和时 fail-closed（可用 --allow-unverified 显式跳过）。
findings.evidence: scripts/install_camoufox.py:290 `_download(asset_url, archive_path)` → :292 `_extract_zip`；_validate_addon_zip（:195-203）只用于 uBlock；主资产没有任何 sha256/签名比对，URL 由 browser-pin.json 的 repo/version/build 拼出（:274-275）。

findings.title: merge 直接对 --target 写库：无备份、无 live-service 检查
findings.impact: 合并的胜负规则（updated_at 新者胜）一旦判错或 merge 逻辑有 bug，没有可回滚的快照；对着正在跑的服务合并还会撞 sqlite 写锁（默认 5s busy timeout）导致中途异常——虽然事务回滚不会写坏，但操作者没有任何恢复点。
findings.fix_hint: 默认先 `sqlite3.Connection.backup()` 出 `<target>.bak-<ts>`（或要求 --no-backup 才跳过）；检测 `-wal` 有活跃读者/写者时提示先停服；把备份路径打进报告。
findings.evidence: scripts/merge_platform_dbs.py:71 `merge_accounts(target, sources, dry_run=args.dry_run)`；core/db/merge.py:181 `sqlite3.connect(str(target))` 读写打开，:250 末尾一次 commit。脚本只有 --dry-run 开关，无 `.bak` 生成、无 `--backup`、不检查目标库是否被运行中的服务持有。

findings.title: _pending_2fa_attempts is never pruned when a temp token expires — unbounded dict growth
findings.impact: Anyone who knows the panel password but not the TOTP secret can mint temp tokens indefinitely (one login + one wrong code each) and grow the dict without bound — a slow memory leak on a long-running single-process panel.
findings.fix_hint: Prune `_pending_2fa_attempts` in the same sweep as `_pending_2fa` (delete keys whose token is no longer in `_pending_2fa`), or store the counter inside the `_pending_2fa` entry.
findings.evidence: api/auth.py:438 `_pending_2fa_attempts[body.temp_token] = attempts`; the only cleanup is `pop` on successful verification or on the 5th failure, and `_prune_pending_2fa()` (called from login/verify) only touches `_pending_2fa`. Expired temp tokens (5-minute TTL) therefore leave their attempt entry behind forever.

findings.title: Unauthenticated share page: no Referrer-Policy/nosniff, iframe uses sandbox=allow-same-origin, and 502 echoes the upstream error text
findings.impact: The share token is a bearer credential in the URL: without Referrer-Policy the full URL can leak to same-origin links, and allow-same-origin gives the (script-less) email document the panel's origin — a single sandbox mistake later turns into stored XSS on the panel origin. Upstream error strings are shown to unauthenticated visitors.
findings.fix_hint: Add `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and a page CSP (`default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; frame-src 'self'`); use `sandbox=""` plus postMessage for height; return a generic message for non-alias_not_found errors.
findings.evidence: api/shared_mail.py:68 headers are only `Cache-Control: no-store` + `X-Robots-Tag`; :84 `sandbox="allow-same-origin"`; :157 `_error_page("暂时读不到邮件", str(error), status_code=502)` echoes ICloudError text (HTML-escaped at :144). Probe: page renders, `X-Content-Type-Options`/`Referrer-Policy`/`Content-Security-Policy` absent from the response.

findings.title: Export builds the entire ZIP in memory and returns a second copy (BytesIO + getvalue), so peak RAM is ~2x the archive
findings.impact: Large installations can OOM the single worker during export (the same failure mode the import path guards against with MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES).
findings.fix_hint: Write the archive to a temp file under DATA_DIR and return a FileResponse (or stream it), deleting the temp file in a background task.
findings.evidence: services/data_bundle.py:324 `return buffer.getvalue(), filename` after writing every DB and the key into an in-memory `io.BytesIO`; api/backup.py:50-54 then wraps that bytes object in a Response. A 1 GB database therefore needs the snapshot + the ZIP + the returned copy resident at once.

findings.title: /api/backup/info (and the manifest inside every export) discloses absolute filesystem paths
findings.impact: Authenticated users (and anyone who obtains an exported ZIP) learn the deployment's absolute paths and DATA_DIR layout, which helps targeted follow-ups; not exploitable on its own.
findings.fix_hint: Return only the bundle-relative name and size from /api/backup/info; keep data_dir out of the manifest or record only a basename.
findings.evidence: services/data_bundle.py:351 `"source": str(source)` per database and :313 `"data_dir": str(DATA_DIR)` in the manifest. Probe: `GET /api/backup/info -> {"data_dir": "/root/.hermes/cache/scratch/l01probe/data", "databases": [{"name": "account_manager.db", "source": ".../probe.db", ...}]}`.

findings.title: PATCH /accounts/{id} 返回 ciphertext extra_json + 明文 password/token，与 GET 详情(明文 extra)契约不一致
findings.impact: 同一资源三个端点三种形状（list=slim+has_*、detail=明文 extra、PATCH=密文 extra）；任何按「PATCH 返回即最新对象」写的前端/脚本会把 v1: 密文当 AT 复制走。
findings.fix_hint: PATCH 复用 get_account 的序列化（model_copy + 解密 extra + no-store 头），或干脆只返回 `{"ok": true}` 让调用方重取详情。
findings.evidence: api/accounts.py:959 `return account_repository.upsert(acc)`：acc 来自仓储，extra_json 列落盘即 `v1:` 密文（core/db/models_account.py 的 set_extra 加密），而 GET 详情(:933-935) 特意 `model_copy(update={'extra_json': json.dumps(acc.get_extra())})` 解成明文；password/token 两个 computed_field 在两个端点都是明文。前端目前忽略 PATCH 响应（Accounts.tsx:693 只 await 后 load()），所以尚未爆出。

findings.title: 单账号/批量检测端点无前端调用方；且 chatgpt 分支被整段跳过，状态与探针新凭证都不落库
findings.impact: 两个端点属死接口（UI 无入口）；若通过 API 直接调用，chatgpt 账号的检测是「跑一次网络请求然后什么都不写」，用户以为已测活。同时 AccountStatus 的 expired/invalid→registered 回迁对 chatgpt 永不触发。
findings.fix_hint: 要么删掉这两个端点，要么给 chatgpt 分支接上 services/chatgpt_account_state.apply_chatgpt_status_policy + persist_probe_credentials（与 api/actions.py 的探测路径对齐）。
findings.evidence: api/accounts.py:1002 POST /accounts/{id}/check 与 :897 /check-all 在 frontend/src 下无任何调用（`grep -rn "accounts/.*check" frontend/src` 只命中 proxies 与 icloud）。且 _do_check:1030 `if fresh.platform != "chatgpt":` 把状态判定、persist_probe_credentials、mark_probe_checked 全包在非 chatgpt 分支里，chatgpt 只更新 updated_at；platforms/chatgpt/plugin.py:113-143 check_valid 只返回 bool、不改传入对象，所以 chatgpt 账号点「检测」既不改状态也不保存探测到的新 AT。core/scheduler.py:207 的批量路径有同样的 `if fresh.platform != "chatgpt"` 结构。

findings.title: task_logs 两种后端返回的键不一致：JSON 给 detail，SQLite 给 detail_json（docstring 声称已统一）
findings.impact: 任何按 detail_json 读的后端代码/脚本在 JSON 后端下永远拿到空值（反之亦然）；切换存储后端时是静默数据丢失，不是报错。
findings.fix_hint: 两处都输出同一个键（建议 detail，值为解析后的 dict；detail_json 作为兼容别名同时给），并补一条契约测试断言两种后端 key 集合相同。
findings.evidence: _from_json 用 _FIELDS=("id",...,"detail","created_at") 返回 `detail`；_from_sqlite 返回 `detail_json`（34 行）。模块 docstring 第 7-11 行写「SQLite 版返回 TaskLog 模型、JSON 版返回 dict —— 这里统一成 dict，上层不必关心后端」，只统一了类型没统一键名。当前前端 TaskLogItem 不读这两个键，所以尚未炸。

findings.title: _run_account_batch_task 的异常收尾没有 try 包裹：finish()/persist 再抛一次就把行留在 running
findings.impact: 收尾写失败 → 线程带着异常退出，DB 行仍是 running；要等下一次任意 /tasks 请求触发 _finalize_orphan_tasks 才会被标 stopped（多进程部署下永远不会）。属低频但正是「卡在 running 永远」的形状。
findings.fix_hint: 照抄 _run_register 的收尾：finish 与 persist 各自 try/except 并 log，异常只记录不再抛。
findings.evidence: except Exception 分支里直接 `_api.task_store.finish(...)`（1183）然后 `_persist_task_snapshot(task_id)`（1192），都不在 try 里；对比 _run_register 的同一路径明确写了 try/except 并注释「收尾路径自己绝不能再抛」（907-930）。finish() 用 self._records[task_id]（KeyError 若记录已被 cleanup 摘掉），persist 可能撞 DB 锁。

findings.title: has_active_register_task 的 docstring 说「注册入口用它做互斥」，实际唯一调用方是 data_bundle 导出
findings.impact: 读代码的人会以为「同来源不会并发两个注册任务」，据此推断锁存在；实际两个请求可以同时开两个注册任务抢同一批邮箱/代理（POST /tasks/register 无互斥）。这是文档承诺了不存在的控制。
findings.fix_hint: 要么在 enqueue_register_task 里真的加检查（409），要么把 docstring 改成「仅供导出判断」，别让下一个人以为有锁。
findings.evidence: docstring：「注册入口用它做互斥：同一来源已经在跑时不再开第二个」。grep 全仓（排除 .worktrees）：唯一调用是 services/data_bundle.py:597-599（导出前判断能否打包）；api/tasks.py:31 只是 re-export，enqueue_register_task 里没有任何 has_active_register_task 检查。

findings.title: get_next 声称「偏向高成功率」，实际是排序后对整个列表做轮转 —— 排序对选择毫无影响
findings.impact: 与文档承诺不符（doc drift），也会误导后续调参：想「少用差出口」的人会以为已经生效。生产库里 id=7 成功率 13% 仍按 1/5 的份额被轮转到。
findings.fix_hint: 要么删掉排序与 docstring 的「biased」说法，要么真做加权：按 `max(success,1)/(success+fail)` 做权重轮盘（random.choices 带 weights），并对成功率 < 阈值的直接跳过。
findings.evidence: docstring :50 `Return the next active proxy, biased toward higher success rate.`；实现 72-79 行 `proxies.sort(key=成功率, reverse=True)` 之后 `idx = self._index % len(proxies); self._index += 1; return proxies[idx].url`。因为 `_index` 会一直自增、遍历整个列表，每个元素都必然被返回，排序只是改变了返回顺序，不会让好出口被选中更多次。

findings.title: rebalance 文档承诺「每个代理相差不超过 1」，实际只搬不合规的号；生产库 363/355/351/349/243
findings.impact: 用户点「均衡绑定」后看到分布几乎没变（只挪了孤儿号），会认为功能坏了；文档里的 ±1 承诺也无法用来验收。
findings.fix_hint: docstring 改成「只把不合规的号补到最轻的代理，不动已合规的号」；若真要拉平，加一个 `rebalance_all` 选项：对超过均值 +1 的代理迁出多余账号（需要搬号时同样写回 update_extra）。
findings.evidence: docstring :275-276 `每次分配都重新读一次计数，所以是逐号贪心，最终每个代理的账号数相差不超过 1`。两处不符：(a) 计数只在函数开头读一次（:287），之后靠本地 `counts[target]["total"] += 1` 累加，不是「每次重新读」；(b) 只处理「不合规」的号（:294-296 `if current and current in bindable: skipped += 1; continue`），已经在池里但分布很歪的号一个都不动。只读实测生产库：363 / 355 / 351 / 349 / 243（1661 个绑定，5 个出口），最大差 120。

findings.title: 均衡预览用 email 做 React key（跨平台重名必然重复），且 items 被截断到 200 而 changed 是全量
findings.impact: 预览列表可能错行/漏渲染；对账时 changed 与 items 数量对不上容易被当成 bug 排查。
findings.fix_hint: key 改 `${item.platform}:${item.email}`；后端 items 里补 `account_id`（rebalance 的 changed 里已有 email/platform，加 id 即可），前端用它做 key。
findings.evidence: `{res.items.map((item) => (<div key={item.email}>…`）—— 同一邮箱同时存在于 chatgpt 与 grok 是常态（core/proxy_pool.py:206-209 的注释记录真库 670 个邮箱里 387 个跨平台重名），key 冲突会让 React 复用错行/告警。另一侧 api/proxies.py:213 `for item in result.get("changed", [])[:200]` 只回 200 条，而 :222 `"changed": len(result.get("changed", []))` 是全量 → 预览里「将调整 1200 个账号」但只列 200 条（UI 文案 :364 有说明「预览前 N 条」，属可接受，但契约上 items 与 changed 不等长）。

findings.title: Turnstile solver 的 debug 日志把完整代理串（含口令）打出来，同文件里已有 _redact 却没用
findings.impact: 开 debug 排障时（恰恰是最容易把日志发给别人看的时候）代理口令进日志文件，且这个 solver 常被单独部署/容器化收集日志。
findings.fix_hint: 三处统一改成 `self._redact(proxy)`；`"server"` 那处本应走 `build_playwright_proxy_config`（core/proxy_utils.py:169），顺便消掉手写的 `split(':')` 解析（它同样只认 3/5 段，见 L04-9）。
findings.evidence: `logger.debug(f"Browser {index}: Starting Turnstile solve for URL: {url} ... | Proxy: {proxy}")` —— `proxy` 是原始串。同类：:966 `logger.debug(f"Browser {index}: Creating context with proxy {proxy}")`（3 段分支）与 :968 `"server": f"{proxy}"`。同文件 :207-216 定义了 `_redact()`（`***:***@host`）并在 :201 用了它。触发条件：`--debug` / `self.debug` 为真。

findings.title: tools/resin_*.py 一次性脚本：不检查子进程返回码、走明文 HTTP 的 ip-api、写死绝对输出路径、模板里的口令是占位符
findings.impact: 扫描结果不可信（失败被当成 IP 写入 json），且这些 json 是「选哪个 ISP 出口」的决策依据；脚本无法在新机器上直接跑。
findings.fix_hint: `if proc.returncode != 0 or not ip: continue`；ip-api 换 https（免费版 https 需 key，或改用 ipinfo）；路径用 `pathlib.Path(__file__).parent`；占位符改 argparse/env 注入。
findings.evidence: 35-40 行 `proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)` 之后直接 `ip = proc.stdout.strip()`，从不看 `proc.returncode` —— curl 失败时 stdout 为空/带错误文本，会被当成 IP 传给 `ip_info()`（`http://ip-api.com/json/{ip}`，明文 HTTP，无 key，免费额度 45/min）。输出路径写死 `OUT = "/data/workspace/Register/tools/resin_default_isp.json"`（仓库换路径即失效）。同族脚本 `resin_scan_asn.py:13`、`resin_scan_default.py:12` 的 RESIN 模板口令是字面量 `***`（照抄即连不上），只有 resin_pair_probe.py:14 是真实口令（见 L04-1）。subprocess 均为 list 参数、未用 shell=True（已逐文件确认，无注入面）。

findings.title: new_alias_share_token 两份实现，且注释把“唯一实现”指错方向

findings.impact: 死代码 + 危险面：任何人日后从门面调到它就会在远端创建别名（用户明确禁止），且它依赖 `client.create_alias`（remote_client 中仍保留）。

findings.title: poll_once 里重复声明 nonlocal _token_refreshed
findings.impact: 无功能影响；读代码时容易误判有两个变量，属清理项。

findings.title: _normalize_backend_name 把 mailapi_url 折叠成 graph，已注册的第三个后端名无法通过配置选中
findings.impact: 用户/运维在配置里写 outlook_backend=mailapi_url 会被静默改成 graph（无 OAuth 时再降级 IMAP），配置项与实现不一致；MailAPI 账号本身仍能走对，故仅属死面。

findings.title: 文档漂移：/panels 注释写「6 个面板」，实际 4 个；推送语义注释成了孤儿块
findings.impact: 维护者按注释找常量会找不到；「6 个面板」会让人以为漏注册了两个面板（本仓库历史上确实出现过 13 个面板的错误简报）。
findings.fix_hint: 改成「4 个面板」或直接删除数字；把 `_PANEL_PUSH_KIND` 的说明搬到 panel_push.py 常量旁，integrations.py 只留一句引用。
findings.evidence: api/integrations.py:50 `逐个面板取会把 6 个面板放大成 7 次读盘` —— services/panel_registry.py:52-123 的 PANELS 长度为 4（cpa/sub2api/grok2api/chatgpt2api）。api/integrations.py:145-163 是一整块讲 `overwrite`/`append` 的注释，但常量 `_PANEL_PUSH_KIND` 实际定义在 services/panel_push.py:345，注释与代码分居两个文件、中间隔 13 行空行。

findings.title: 自定义贡献上传绕过面板 TLS 策略，且先解析 JSON 再看状态码
findings.impact: 自建自签贡献服务器无法使用（只能全局关校验，反而更不安全）；对端 4xx/5xx 的真实原因在 UI 上不可见，排障只能看日志。
findings.fix_hint: 加 `verify=verify_for('contribution')`；先判 status 再尝试 json，非 JSON 时把 `resp.text[:200]` 放进错误消息。
findings.evidence: services/external_sync.py:214-225：`requests.post(... timeout=15)` 没有 `verify=verify_for(...)`（默认 True 所以不是不安全，但 `panel_tls_ca_bundle` 对自签贡献服务器无效）；:225 `data = resp.json()` 在 `if resp.status_code >= 400` 之前执行，HTML 错误页会抛 JSONDecodeError 被 :233 的宽 except 吞成「上传到自定义贡献系统失败」，丢失真实状态码/错误体。

findings.title: grok2api 无 secret_key：/panels 的 secret_set 对它恒为 False
findings.impact: 面板清单接口对 grok2api 声称「未设置口令」，与配置页（PanelConfigPanel 用 grok2api_password_set）口径不一致；当前面板管理页不消费该字段，属契约层错误。
