findings.evidence: services/panel_registry.py:96-105 grok2api 项没有 `secret_key`（实际口令是 `grok2api_password`，见 core/config_schema.py:111 与 panel_comparison_cache.py:171-173）；api/integrations.py:57-62 由 secret_key 推导 `secret_set`，因此恒 False。

findings.title: 16 of the 30 `npm run check` scripts are source-text regex gates, not behavioral assertions
findings.impact: These 16 gates cannot fail when behavior breaks — only when an identifier is renamed. They are counted in the same “all checks passed” line as the real ones, so the green output overstates coverage (e.g. the silent-failure gate does not cover L08-2's uncaught toggle).
findings.fix_hint: Port the 16 to the rolldown pattern (export the handler logic from the page/component, or extract the branch into lib/ and assert on it); at minimum label them “source-shape” in the check output so green ≠ behavioral coverage.
findings.evidence: Classified all 30: 14 execute the real TS module through rolldown and assert on returned values (account_format, attention, chatgpt_token_plan, dashboard_data, dashboard_tasks, finished_cap, log_cleanup, maintenance_keys, panel_actions_by_state, panel_filter, panel_unavailable_display, poll_backoff, pool_status, task_kind). 16 only readFileSync + regex the source text: account_row_field, accounts_list_token, all_actions_are_tasks, authorized_bulk, batch_capability, detail_completeness, form_hint, grok_batch_default, import_format, kiro_derived_paging, panel_action_mapping, panel_filter_driven, panel_upload_entry, probe_task, proxy_release, silent_failure. Example: run_silent_failure_checks.mjs:25 `ok(/message\.error/.test(detailBlock), ...)` — passes if the identifier appears anywhere in the sliced block, regardless of whether the branch is reachable.

findings.title: Data-driven URLs opened with window.open(..., '_blank') without noopener — reverse tabnabbing into the authenticated panel tab
findings.impact: The opened page gets `window.opener` and can rewrite the panel tab to a look-alike login page (the panel tab is same-origin with the JWT-bearing app). Requires a hostile/compromised cashier URL, hence P3, but the mitigation is one string.
findings.fix_hint: `window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')` (or `const w = window.open(); w.opener = null; w.location = url`). Also validate scheme is http(s) before opening.
findings.evidence: Accounts.tsx:1465 `<Button ... aria-label="打开试用链接" ... onClick={() => window.open(url, '_blank')} />`; RegisterTaskPage.tsx:248 `t.cashier_urls.forEach((url: string) => window.open(url, '_blank'))` (cashier_urls comes from the task record / upstream). Both lack the `'noopener'` feature flag, unlike the three panel/GitHub links (PanelManagement.tsx:131,215; PanelConfigPanel.tsx:270,422) which pass it.

findings.title: pytest.ini's own comment cites a stale collection count (3514 vs 3929)
findings.impact: Cosmetic, but it is the number a reviewer uses to decide whether a suite run lost tests; a 415-test gap reads as a collection regression that never happened.
findings.fix_hint: Update the comment, or delete the number and point at tests/test_maintenance_doc.py as the source of truth.
findings.evidence: pytest.ini comment: '`pytest tests/` → 3514 collected + 0 error'. Actual: `pytest --collect-only -q` -> '3929 tests collected in 4.36s'.

findings.title: check_no_secrets only scans git-tracked files and skips any match containing TEST/FAKE/DUMMY
findings.impact: The guard is run before `git add` in practice (it is a pre-commit style check), where new files are exactly the untracked ones it cannot see. It is a real regex scanner (would catch AKIA.../ghp_... in tracked files) but its coverage claim is broader than its reach.
findings.fix_hint: Scan `git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard` so new files are included; drop 'TEST' from FAKE_MARKERS (keep FAKE/EXAMPLE/DUMMY) or require the marker to be a whole token.
findings.evidence: _tracked_files() shells out to `git ls-files -z` (line 45) and falls back to a directory walk only when git is unavailable, so untracked files are never scanned. `if any(marker in value.upper() for marker in FAKE_MARKERS): continue` where FAKE_MARKERS = (FAKE, EXAMPLE, SAMPLE, PLACEHOLDER, DUMMY, REDACTED, TEST) - a live `sk-...TEST...` key is skipped. SKIP_DIRS also drops `data`, `static`, `reference`. Ran: exit 0, 5.40s, prints '未发现密钥字面量。'

findings.title: merge.py 的守恒断言不可达，_KEY_COLUMNS 是死常量
findings.impact: docstring 宣称「任何一条不成立就是数据丢了」的保护实际不存在，运维会误以为合并有自校验；死常量增加阅读成本。真出问题时（如 _insert 中途 IntegrityError）没有任何报告，只有 traceback。
findings.fix_hint: 要么在 _insert 失败时把该行记入 failed 计数并继续（守恒才有意义），要么删掉断言与常量，改为在 report 里输出 before/after 实际行数差。
findings.evidence: _check_conservation() 比较 total 与 inserted+updated+skipped_older+duplicate_in_source，但 _merge_source()（merge.py:167-257）每个分支恰好自增其中一个计数器，等式恒成立；_insert 抛错时是异常传播而非计数缺口。_KEY_COLUMNS = ("platform","email")（merge.py:45）全文件无引用。

findings.title: TokenRefreshResult.expires_at 混用 naive 与 aware datetime，且全仓无人消费
findings.impact: 当前是死字段，无运行时后果；但同一字段两种 tz 语义，任何未来消费方写 `if result.expires_at < datetime.now(timezone.utc)` 都会 TypeError（aware vs naive），或按本地时区误判 8 小时。属于埋给下一个人的坑。
findings.fix_hint: 统一用 `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`，fromisoformat 后 `if dt.tzinfo is None: dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`；或者直接改成 epoch 秒（与 services/chatgpt_token_lifecycle.py 的口径一致）并删掉这个字段。
findings.evidence: grep -n 'expires_at = ' platforms/chatgpt/token_refresh.py -> :253 `datetime.fromisoformat(expires_str.replace("Z", "+00:00"))`（aware，无 Z 时 naive）、:340 `datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=expires_in)`（naive）；`grep -rn '\.expires_at' platforms services webui` 显示除 tests 外无消费方。

findings.title: 补 RT / 绑 2FA 的 account_ids 注解是 Iterable[int]，实际是 UUID 字符串
findings.impact: 纯注解漂移：调用方（api/tasks.py 传 `[str(row.id) ...]`）与注解不符，静态检查/IDE 会给出错误提示，新人容易据此做 int() 转换而把 UUID 打断。
findings.fix_hint: 两处改成 `Optional[Iterable[str]]`，与下游签名对齐。
findings.evidence: grep -n 'account_ids: Optional\[Iterable\[int\]\]' services/chatgpt_rt_backfill.py services/chatgpt_two_factor.py -> 两处均为 `Iterable[int]`，而 select_chatgpt_accounts 的签名是 `Optional[Iterable[str]]` 且 normalize_account_ids 明确接受 UUID/正整数串（chatgpt_account_selection.py:27-50）。

findings.title: BasePlatform._make_executor has no production caller and raises ValueError for the only executor Grok declares
findings.impact: Dead helper that is guaranteed to blow up for the platform whose config it would receive; a future generic caller (e.g. a shared captcha/oauth path) would break Grok at runtime instead of at import.
findings.fix_hint: Delete `_make_executor` (and `_make_captcha` if it has no callers), or teach the factory the platform-declared executor names.
findings.evidence: `grep -rn '_make_executor' --include=*.py .` returns only the definition (core/base_platform.py:331) and tests/test_reusable_modules.py:144. The factory it calls only knows protocol/headless/headed (core/executors/factory.py:20-28), so `create("browser")` raises `ValueError: 未知执行器类型: browser` - and "browser" is Grok's sole declared executor (platforms/grok/plugin.py:143) and therefore the value BasePlatform.__init__ normalizes config.executor_type to.

findings.title: register() silently overwrites a duplicate platform name and silently drops non-enabled ones
findings.impact: A copy-pasted plugin (e.g. platforms/kiro2/plugin.py with `name = "kiro"`) silently replaces the real Kiro class for the whole process; a typo'd name (`name = "grok2"`) registers nothing and the plugin never appears, with no warning in either case.
findings.fix_hint: Log/raise on `cls.name in _registry and _registry[cls.name] is not cls`; log-and-skip unsupported names instead of silently returning.
findings.evidence: `sed -n '30,34p' core/registry.py` -> `if is_platform_enabled(cls.name): _registry[cls.name] = cls` - no duplicate check, no log. `load_all()` walks `pkgutil.iter_modules(platforms.__path__)` (line 41), i.e. filesystem order, so the winner between two modules declaring the same `name` depends on directory iteration order.

findings.title: AWS build_extra persists the spent OIDC device_code/user_code into account extra forever
findings.impact: Every AWS account permanently carries a stale single-use credential in extra_json: dead weight in every list/detail/backup payload, and one more secret to leak if the decryption key is compromised.
findings.fix_hint: Remove both keys from CREDENTIAL_KEYS (they are transient), or pop them from the account extra after `device_token` succeeds.
findings.evidence: `CREDENTIAL_KEYS` contains `user_code` and `device_code` (platforms/aws/credentials.py:34-35), so `build_extra` writes the device grant returned by `device_authorization` (platforms/aws/client.py:1401-1402) into `extra` and nothing removes it after the token exchange. `device_code` is at least encrypted (core/credential_crypto.py:77) but has no reader anywhere (`grep -rn device_code` shows only producers and oauth flows).

findings.title: platforms/grok/__init__.py imports .plugin, contradicting the package-level rule written in platforms/aws/__init__.py
findings.impact: `import platforms.grok.constants` (or any future tool that only wants the endpoints) drags in the full plugin module and its imports (core.base_mailbox, services.panel_status_sync, ...); two import paths to the same class make circular-import regressions more likely as the plugin grows.
findings.fix_hint: Drop the re-export from platforms/grok/__init__.py (keep the module map docstring); import `platforms.grok.plugin` explicitly where the class is needed.
findings.evidence: `from .plugin import GrokPlatform` (platforms/grok/__init__.py:21) vs platforms/aws/__init__.py:15-18: "**不要在包 `__init__` 里 import `plugin`**：`core.registry.load_all()` 是按 `platforms.<name>.plugin` 逐个导入的，包级 import 会让「只想要 crypto 的测试」也被平台依赖拖起来（并制造循环导入）".

findings.title: check_valid() reports every default (SSO-only) Grok account as invalid, so batch 有效性检查 counts the whole pool as failed
findings.impact: A pool of healthy SSO-only Grok accounts reports N invalid on every scheduled check (account status is not written, because the grok policy returns "" for code=None). The operator's only aggregate signal is wrong, and it contradicts the aws/kiro convention where the same situation is `usable=None` / indeterminate.
findings.fix_hint: Return `usable: None, indeterminate: True` for the no-AT branch (matching aws/kiro) and let check_valid/consumers treat None as '测不了'; keep the explicit 测活 action message that tells the user to run 刷新 Token.
findings.evidence: `check_valid` returns `bool(detail.get("usable"))` (platforms/grok/plugin.py:307) and `probe_account_detail` returns `{"usable": False, "code": None, "summary": "SSO 探测：..."}` whenever the account has no AT (plugin.py:344-365) - which is the default product of registration. `core/scheduler.check_accounts_valid` increments `results["invalid"]` for those (core/scheduler.py:202-208).

findings.title: platforms/icloud/ is an empty package left behind after the iCloud platform was retired
findings.impact: Dead package in the plugin discovery root; pkgutil still yields it on every load_all() and it is skipped only because of the name filter, so it invites confusion about whether iCloud is a platform or the mailbox channel.
findings.fix_hint: Delete platforms/icloud/ (the local mailbox provider lives in modules/mail/icloud_local.py).
findings.evidence: `ls platforms/icloud` -> only `__init__.py` (no plugin.py, no code), while core/registry.py:11-17 documents that the iCloud platform was removed and SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS excludes it.

findings.title: CaptchaChain 缺 solve_image 且 solve_turnstile 只收 **kwargs，与 VerificationHandler 的调用签名不兼容（当前是死代码）
findings.impact: 今天不触发；一旦有人把 CaptchaChain 接到 VerificationHandler（它本来就是「把 captcha solver 适配成 challenge」的适配器），turnstile 会 `TypeError: takes 1 positional argument`，image 会 `AttributeError: no attribute 'solve_image'`——错误点在离配置很远的验证步骤。
findings.fix_hint: 给 CaptchaChain 补 `solve_image`（转发给实现了该能力的 provider，全不支持时抛 CaptchaProviderError）并把 `solve_turnstile` 改成 `(website_url, website_key)` 位置参数；或者删掉 VerificationHandler，改用 Protocol 约束。
findings.evidence: `core/captcha_providers.py:353 class CaptchaChain` 只有 `solve_aws_waf(**kwargs)`（:379）与 `solve_turnstile(**kwargs)`（:382），**没有** `solve_image`（文件里两个 `solve_image` 分别属于 CapMonster :179 与 AiVision :275）。`modules/verification/challenges.py:26-29` 却按位置调用：`self._captcha.solve_turnstile(challenge.page_url, challenge.site_key)` / `self._captcha.solve_image(challenge.image_b64)`。`build_captcha_chain()` 被注入 `platforms/aws/plugin.py:98`、`platforms/kiro/plugin.py:364`，但下游 `AwsBuilderIdClient` 只调 `solve_aws_waf`（platforms/aws/client.py:269）；`grep -rn "VerificationHandler" --include=*.py .` 只有定义与 `modules/verification/__init__.py` 的导出，无调用方。

findings.title: run_log_cleanup(now=...) 在 SQLite 后端被忽略：cutoff 由墙钟重算，与 JSON 后端行为不一致
findings.impact: 默认（SQLite）后端下 `now=` 参数是摆设：测试/回填想用固定时间点做确定性清理时，实际按墙钟删；同一函数在 JSON 后端却按 `now` 删，两个后端语义分叉。正常生产调用（now=None）无影响，故 P3。
findings.fix_hint: 给 `cleanup_task_logs` 加可选 `now`/`cutoff` 参数并在 SQL 分支使用同一个 `cutoff_dt`；`run_log_cleanup` 两个分支都传 `cutoff_dt`。
findings.evidence: `local_maintenance.py:636 cutoff_dt = (now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)) - timedelta(days=keep_days)` 只用于 `:641 task_log_repository.cleanup_json(cutoff_dt)`；SQLite 分支 `:665 summary["deleted"] = int(cleanup_task_logs(keep_days))`，而 `services/log_cleanup.py:41` 内部又 `cutoff = retention_cutoff(older_than_days)` = `datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=...)` —— 传进来的 `now` 完全没参与。

findings.title: 已分配到号但信息不完整时直接 continue 再租：前一个 activation 既不取消也不记录，可能一次租号扣两次费
findings.impact: 平台返回 `activationId` 但号码字段缺失/改名（getNumberV2 各站字段不完全一致）时，第一次分配已经计费且没有被取消、也没有写进 `current_activation`，上层之后想 cancel 都找不到 id；第二次 getNumber 再扣一次。
findings.fix_hint: `if activation_id: self.cancel(activation_id)` 后再 continue；`_format_phone` 兼容 `phone`/`number` 别名；把「已分配未使用」的 id 记进日志便于对账。
findings.evidence: `providers.py:479 for action in ("getNumberV2", "getNumber")`；成功返回后 `:487-491 activation_id = str(info.get("activationId") or ""); phone = self._format_phone(info); if not activation_id or not phone.strip("+"): failures.append(...); continue` —— 这里没有 `self.cancel(activation_id)`，循环继续用下一个 action 再租一个。`_format_phone`（:432-441）只认 `phoneNumber`/`countryPhoneCode` 两个键。

findings.title: solver.log 无轮转，且每次求解固定 print 两行：长期运行磁盘单调增长
findings.impact: 长跑实例的 solver.log 在 DATA_DIR 卷里无上界增长（还混着 L13-1 的口令泄漏）；compose 的 json-file 10m×3 限制只作用于容器 stdout，管不到这个文件。
findings.fix_hint: 用 `logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler(maxBytes=10MB, backupCount=3)` 或给 solver.log 配 logrotate；`save_result` 的 print 降到 debug 级。
findings.evidence: `services/solver_manager.py:108-109` `log_path = str(LOG_DIR / "solver.log"); _log_file = open(log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8")`，`stop()` 只 close，从不 rotate/truncate；`services/turnstile_solver/db_results.py:13` 每次 `save_result` 都 `print(f"[系统] 任务 {task_id} 状态更新: {data.get('value','正在处理')}")` —— 每个 /turnstile 请求至少 2 行（提交 + 结果）。`services/log_cleanup.py` 只删 `task_logs`/`task_runs` 表行，不碰这个文件。

findings.title: .env.example image example still shows tag `:0.1` while the release convention is 1.0.0 / 1.0 / latest
findings.impact: Stale example tag; users may pin a non-current 0.1 tag or think the naming scheme is inconsistent.
findings.fix_hint: Change the example to `:1.0` / `:1.0.0`.
findings.evidence: .env.example:14 `# 想钉住别的版本就改这里，例如 .../auto-register:0.1 或 :latest。`; :16 `# APP_IMAGE=ghcr.io/ifuzyi/auto-register:1.0.0`; docker-compose.yml:18 defaults to `1.0.0`; README.md:37 lists `1.0.0` / `1.0` / `latest`.

findings.title: .env.example says the solver pool defaults to 4 threads / 1.0 GiB, but solver_manager defaults to 1-2 threads
findings.impact: Users size hosts for 1 GiB when the backend-managed pool is ~250-500 MiB, and cannot find the tuning knob; the doc also hides that the solver's own default 4 only applies when started manually.
findings.fix_hint: Document the effective default and `SOLVER_THREADS`; keep the manual-start default note separate.
findings.evidence: .env.example:96-97 `池按 --thread（默认 4）预热后每个浏览器约 250 MiB，常驻不动实测占 1.0 GiB`; solver_manager.py:20-45 `_solver_threads()` returns 1 when RAM < 4GB else `min(2, cpu_count)`, and :119-121 always passes `--thread` to the solver. `SOLVER_THREADS` (the override) is absent from .env.example and DEPLOYMENT.md.

findings.title: Dockerfile base images are floating tags, not digest-pinned
findings.impact: Two builds of the same commit can differ (base packages, Node/Python patch levels, browser deps), making 'works on my build' reports irreproducible.
findings.fix_hint: Pin both images by digest (and optionally the apt snapshot), with a documented update PR.
findings.evidence: Dockerfile:11-12 `ARG NODE_IMAGE=node:20-bookworm-slim` / `ARG PYTHON_IMAGE=python:3.12-slim`; no `@sha256:` anywhere (`grep -n 'sha256' Dockerfile` -> none). DEPLOYMENT.md:18 promises browser-version pinning (camoufox browser-pin), but the OS/Python/Node base layers still move with upstream tags.

findings.title: Dockerfile installs Playwright Firefox that no code path uses
findings.impact: Adds a large unused browser (~90MB+) and build time; DEPLOYMENT.md:16 only promises Chromium + Camoufox, so the extra download is also undocumented.
findings.fix_hint: Drop `firefox` from the playwright install (keep chromium), or document the reason if a path needs it.
findings.evidence: Dockerfile:72 `python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox`; `grep -rn 'firefox' --include=*.py platforms services core` only finds fingerprint/UA strings (e.g. platforms/chatgpt/protocol/fingerprint.py:115-116), no `playwright.firefox.launch`; Grok uses camoufox (platforms/grok/register_browser.py:8) and the solver defaults to camoufox.

findings.title: DATA_DIRECTORY says the TOTP journal is plaintext; code now stores `totp_secret_cipher` encrypted
findings.impact: Security documentation understates the protection and misleads backup/secret-handling decisions; the journal is not plaintext for new entries.
findings.fix_hint: Change both lines to '加密后的密钥（totp_secret_cipher；旧格式可能为明文）' and keep the 0700/0600 note.
findings.evidence: docs/DATA_DIRECTORY.md:16 `2FA 绑定过程的明文密钥 journal` and :27 `写前密钥日志（明文；目录 0700 / 文件 0600）`; services/chatgpt_two_factor.py:222 `里面是**加密后**的密钥（T1.5）` and :258 writes `"totp_secret_cipher": encrypt_text(secret)` (legacy `totp_secret` plaintext is read only as fallback).

findings.title: DEPLOYMENT/FEATURES link to a nonexistent README anchor `#部署方式`
findings.impact: The link lands at the top of README instead of the deployment section; minor navigation break.
findings.fix_hint: Link to `#快速开始` or add a `## 部署方式` heading above the two deployment subsections.
findings.evidence: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md:4 `[README 的部署方式](../README.md#部署方式)`; docs/FEATURES.md:4 same link. `grep -n '^#' README.md` lists `## 快速开始`, `### Docker Compose（推荐）`, `### 裸机部署`, but no `部署方式` heading; `grep -n '部署方式' README.md` only finds the doc-index table text.

findings.title: DEPLOYMENT env table calls STORAGE_BACKEND default 'sqlite' while code defaults fresh deployments to json
findings.impact: The row contradicts itself and the code; a reader may assume a fresh install creates SQLite (it does not).
findings.fix_hint: Change the default cell to '全新=json；已有库=sqlite' and drop the parenthetical 'sqlite（默认）'.
findings.evidence: DEPLOYMENT.md:143 row: `| STORAGE_BACKEND | 见下 | sqlite（默认）或 json。不填时：全新部署用 json...` (the row says sqlite is the default, then says fresh installs use json); core/storage/__init__.py:43-44 `DEFAULT_BACKEND = BACKEND_JSON`, :67-69 returns json when no DB exists and no explicit value.

findings.title: requirements.txt declares six unused packages and relies on an undeclared transitive (platformdirs)
findings.impact: Image bloat and a hidden dependency: a future camoufox change that drops platformdirs breaks the solver at import time.
findings.fix_hint: Remove the six unused entries; add `platformdirs` explicitly or import it lazily with a fallback.
findings.evidence: requirements.txt:11-18 declares `jwcrypto`, `cbor2`, `aiofiles`, `httpx`, `selectolax`, `names`; an AST import scan of 253 .py files under main.py/core/api/services/platforms/modules/tools/scripts found none of them imported (only occurrences are requirements.txt itself). `platformdirs` is imported at services/turnstile_solver/start.py:23 and scripts/install_camoufox.py but is not declared; it is currently present only as a camoufox dependency.

findings.title: modules/automation (217-line pipeline) + modules/verification have no production caller at all; the documented entry point from_application_defaults is called by nothing, not even a test
findings.impact: ~370 lines (pipeline.py 217, registration.py 77, icloud.py 38, challenges.py 32) are reachable only from one test file; the copy in .worktrees/dev/services/task_runners.py:41 still imports it, so the main tree lost the caller during the refactor and the module was left behind. The documented extension path is unexercised, so it can rot silently (it already depends on three lazily imported seams: modules.execution, modules.mail, modules.proxy).
findings.fix_hint: Either wire it back (task_runners) or delete modules/automation + modules/verification and the corresponding section of docs/EXTENDING.md; at minimum add one test that calls from_application_defaults() so the documented path is executed.
findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'modules\.automation' --include=*.py` outside modules/ and tests/ returns only two comments (core/executors/factory.py:4, core/mailboxes/registry.py:23), no import. modules/verification is imported only by modules/automation/pipeline.py:14. RegistrationPipeline/RegistrationRequest/AutomationHooks/VerificationChallenge/ICloudAliasWorkflow/PlatformRegistrationService appear outside modules/ only in tests/test_reusable_modules.py (:6,9,12,15,184,215...). RegistrationPipeline.from_application_defaults (pipeline.py:99) has zero callers repo-wide, yet docs/EXTENDING.md:160 instructs users to call it.

findings.title: Two browser-runtime tests assert nothing: they pass if the function body is replaced by `pass`
findings.impact: The Windows-without-DISPLAY and headless paths have no pinned behaviour beyond 'does not raise'; a regression that raises on win32 would be caught, but one that silently changes the decision would not. Low blast radius (the linux negative case is covered).
findings.fix_hint: Assert the return value (or assert it is None and add a companion test that a bogus platform raises ValueError) so the decision, not just the absence of an exception, is pinned.
findings.evidence: tests/test_browser_runtime.py:6-7 and :15-16 call ensure_browser_display_available(...) and have no assertion and no pytest.raises. Only :10-12 (`test_headed_browser_requires_display_on_linux`) pins behaviour. If core/browser_runtime.ensure_browser_display_available were reduced to `def ...: pass`, both tests stay green.

findings.title: Structural 'no raw account writes remain' gate scans only api/ + services/ and carries a dead exemption branch that can never trigger
findings.impact: The test's message claims '仍有原生账号写' is impossible, but the checker cannot see core/ or platforms/ or any `.add(row)` form. The very split-brain bug the docstring describes (read JSON / write SQLite -> '新建的账号查不到') could reappear outside the two scanned packages and the gate stays green.
findings.fix_hint: Walk the repo root (excluding tests/, .worktrees/, reference/), match `session.add(<anything>)` where the argument is assigned from AccountModel, and delete the unused allow_row_files branch or populate it.
findings.evidence: tests/test_storage_coverage_gate.py:100 defines `allow_row_files: set[str] = set()` and never adds to it, so the guard at :108 (`if pat == patterns[-1] and rel in allow_row_files`) is always False — dead branch. The scan at :101 walks only `api/` and `services/`; patterns at :95-99 match only `.add(acc)`, `.add(account)`, `.add(acc_model)` and not `.add(row)`. A raw account write at platforms/grok/migrate_sso_only.py:99 (`session.add(row)` on AccountModel, followed by commit at :103) is therefore invisible to the gate (currently harmless only because :84 `all_tables_use_json()` returns early on the JSON backend).

findings.title: 加密开关的 docstring 与实现不符：关掉后读侧仍解密、写侧落明文
findings.impact: `CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION=0` 下读 v1: 值仍会解密（行为正确），但写回一律明文 —— 库变成明文/密文混合，而文档声称不会发生；排障时按文档理解会误判『读出来是明文说明没加密』
findings.fix_hint: 修正 docstring 为『读侧始终解密以兼容存量密文，写侧在关闭时落明文』；关闭且检测到存量密文时打 warning
findings.evidence: docstring 29-30 行『关掉时两个函数都退化成恒等映射』；decrypt_text（107-118）全文没有 `enabled()` 判断，只有 encrypt_text（98）有

findings.title: PlaywrightExecutor 与 headless/headed 分支在生产链路上不可达（死代码）
findings.impact: headless/headed 两条分支与整个 PlaywrightExecutor（L16-6/L16-7 的宿主）没有任何生产调用点，只在 tests/test_core_executors_and_captcha.py 里被构造；同时 BasePlatform.supported_executors 默认值 `["protocol","headless","headed"]` 仍会向未覆写该字段的第三方插件宣称支持三种执行器 —— 界面说支持、运行时不生效
findings.fix_hint: 要么删掉 PlaywrightExecutor 与两个分支，要么把 _make_executor 接进真实流程；默认 supported_executors 收窄为实际实现的那一项
findings.evidence: grep -rn '_make_executor' --include=*.py . | grep -v .worktrees -> 只有定义 core/base_platform.py:331，零调用点；grep -rn 'executor_type' platforms/ -> 无命中；唯一的生产 create 调用是 platforms/grok/plugin.py:430 `BrowserExecutorFactory().create("protocol", proxy=proxy)`

findings.title: ProxyRecord.to_dict 不包含 id / tags，from_dict(to_dict()) 会丢主键与选路标签
findings.impact: 任何走 `from_dict(rec.to_dict())` 的 JSON 往返都会丢 id 与 tags → 代理的 register/bind 选路标签静默清空（正是模块 docstring 声称已修好的『JSON 分支丢字段』同类问题）；目前仓库内写路径是手写 dict，所以尚未触发
findings.fix_hint: to_dict 补 `id` 与 `tags: proxy_tags_csv(self.tags)`，并加一条 round-trip 测试
findings.evidence: sed -n '105,113p' core/models/proxy.py -> 只输出 url/region/success_count/fail_count/is_active/last_checked；from_dict（85-103）会读 `record.get("id")` 与 `parse_proxy_tags(record.get("tags"))`；全仓无 to_dict 调用点（当前潜在）

findings.title: persist_probe_credentials 的 session 参数从未使用，写回也不落库；indeterminate 时丢弃已轮换的 RT
findings.impact: 签名暗示『传 session 就会持久化』，实际只改内存模型；调用方若漏掉后续 `account_repository.save/upsert`（services/action_execution.py:397 之后有 save，api/accounts.py:1049 之后有 upsert，属于侥幸对齐）就静默丢失刚换回的 RT。另外 `usable is None`（5xx/429/网络不明的 indeterminate）时 detail 里的新凭据一律丢弃 —— 若上游已在这次失败探测中轮换了 RT，旧 RT 已失效、新 RT 被扔掉，账号从此不可恢复
findings.fix_hint: 删掉未用的 session 参数（或提供时直接 save）；对『值与原值不同』的 refresh_token 无条件写回，与 usable 结论解耦
findings.evidence: sed -n '14,21p' core/probe_credentials.py -> 签名有 `session=None`，函数体（22-38 行）从未引用；20 行 `if not detail.get("usable") ...: return False` 在任何写入之前返回

findings.title: merge 的 table 名用 f-string 拼进 SQL（PRAGMA/select/insert/update）
findings.impact: 当前不可从命令行注入；但这是公开库函数，未来任何调用方把用户输入接到 table 上就是 SQL 注入（列名来自目标 schema，值仍参数化）。
findings.fix_hint: table 用 `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` 白名单校验并加双引号，或直接只允许 'accounts'。
findings.evidence: core/db/merge.py:113 `PRAGMA table_info({table})`、:191/:195/:210 `select ... from {table}`、:276 `insert into {table}`、:285 `update {table} set`；table 是 merge_accounts 的关键字参数（:170，默认 "accounts"），CLI 未暴露。

findings.title: check_dead_tests 在 tests 目录不存在时空转并以 0 退出
findings.impact: `python scripts/check_dead_tests.py test/`（少个 s）或从非仓库根运行都是绿色门禁，实际一个文件都没扫。
findings.fix_hint: `if not root.is_dir(): print(f'{root} 不存在', file=sys.stderr); return 2`。
findings.evidence: scripts/check_dead_tests.py:61 `root = Path(argv[1]) if len(argv) > 1 else Path("tests")`；:63 `root.rglob("*.py")` 对不存在的目录返回空迭代，无 is_dir 检查，:78 `return 1 if failures else 0`。

findings.title: e2e 每次运行遗留 mkdtemp 目录（sqlite 库 + 日志）
findings.impact: 反复跑（CI/本地对比重构前后）会在 /tmp 堆满完整账号库副本与日志，长期跑的小磁盘机器会被填满。
findings.fix_hint: `atexit.register(shutil.rmtree, _TMP, ignore_errors=True)`，或加 --keep 保留。
findings.evidence: scripts/e2e_smoke.py:35 `_TMP = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="e2e-smoke-")`，main()（:289-327）与 _run 都没有清理，报告里还把路径写进 data_dir 字段。

findings.title: 冻结指纹只覆盖 tracked 文件，gitignored 路径的变化看不见；子命令无超时
findings.impact: 测试若写 `data/`（.gitignore:18 已忽略）或 __pycache__，前后指纹相同 → 报「树没动」，而库已被改；命令挂死时 gate 永远不返回。
findings.fix_hint: status 加 `--ignored` 或额外哈希 data/ 下 mtime+size；给子命令 timeout（如 --timeout，默认 1800）并映射到独立退出码。
findings.evidence: scripts/frozen_verify.py:47 `git status --porcelain=v1 -z`（默认不列 ignored）、:48 `git ls-files -z` 只哈希 tracked 文件；:80 `subprocess.run(command, cwd=str(root))` 无 timeout。

findings.title: zipfile.extractall 解压下载包，未防 zip-slip
findings.impact: release 资产被替换时可用 `../../` 成员写到 version_dir 之外（构建期任意文件写）；来源是 GitHub 官方 release，概率低但和 L17-7 叠加。
findings.fix_hint: 遍历 namelist，拒绝绝对路径与含 `..` 的成员后再 extract；或解压到 temp 并校验所有目标都在 dest 下。
findings.evidence: scripts/install_camoufox.py:189-190 `with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf: zf.extractall(dest)`；Python 的 extractall 只剥绝对路径/盘符，不剥 `..` 组件。
